Did you know that roughly 2.3 million Floridians under 65 are living without health insurance, friend?

**And now, he's fully endorsed the Trump-Vance ticket and their Project 2025 agenda, which includes _GUTTING_ Medicare and _REPEALING_ the Affordable Care Act.**
Time and again, Rick Scott reminds us why it's time for him to retire. **That's why Debbie is in the fight of her life to defeat him and give Floridians the leadership they deserve.**

body:
There's no code to break down when we say "rural". We're not talking about voters who are likely to vote one way or another. This is about the working poor and struggling middle class that are continually targeted by opponents of voting rights with little tricks and hidden snares designed to get their votes tossed out or their registrations removed.
We exist to fight these laws, Team. We exist to make every vote count regardless of how it was submitted. RUSH $25 or more right now to stand with us and defend the right to vote nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=083024_4&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=083024_4&amount=25]
DD: Disenfranchising Rural North Carolina Is By Design [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=083024_4&amount=25]
One of the sneakiest things about North Carolina's 2023 voter suppression bill, S.B. 747, is how it disenfranchises rural communities across our state.
The North Carolina state legislature, along party lines, passed a sweeping package of changes to state election laws ahead of the 2024 elections — including throwing out any mail-in ballots not received by Election Night , instead of the current three-day grace period after the election.
The biggest issue for rural activists is the change to the rules for same-day voter registration. S.B. 747 makes it so that many people could go to the polls, lawfully vote, and later learn — or perhaps never learn — that their vote didn’t count. This is because the new law mandates that their ballot will be thrown out if a single piece of mail sent to them after they vote by their county board of elections is returned as undeliverable. Their voter registration would be thrown out, too. And we all know how rural mail service can be unreliable.
Intricate rules like this (or states like Pennsylvania that require the voter to write the date they completed their ballot in multiple, obscure places) are not written because lawmakers don't understand how people vote. Laws like this are written specifically so that opponents of voting rights have legal avenues to throw out your ballot and invalidate your vote . The working poor and struggling middle class are most likely to get caught in this trap, not the wealthy donors who back the vote suppressors.
All voters deserve to have their voices heard in our elections, Team, not to have their ballots tossed out on technicalities. Help fight these suppressive and disenfranchising laws with $25 or whatever you can today and protect voting rights across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=083024_4&amount=25]

In _Mosely and Figueroa v. Rosario_ , 2005, the Bronx Supreme Court sated that "[E]lectoral contests are not a street brawl, where anything goes."
Donald Trump's filthy outrage on social media seems more characteristic of a middle-school boy's taunt in a street fight than the remarks of a statesman vying for a second bid at the White House. The attack was [called out in the New York Times by Michael Gold.](https://substack.com/redirect/8af3cc17-3ff8-4029-8703-bb56841f9fd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Credit is due to author Robert Hubbell, who asked, ["Are we really not going to talk about this?"](https://substack.com/redirect/3e9580fe-1819-46f6-a72a-f9213e8e7091?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), as well as to MSNBC, Politico, and a handful of media outlets.
Meanwhile, I question _where_ the always-quick-to-the-punch, 3rd ranking Republican, Elise Stefanik is. Indeed, Stefanik's lack of response is tacit approval of the crude and misogynistic assault.
Does Stefanik really not grasp how her grandiose displays at promoting women are tarnished with every moment that she fails to speak up?
On first glance, one might think that Stefanik has done well to protect women. Oh, but wait -- there's that issue of women's health care and reproductive freedom. Then there is Stefanik's much-used "ICYMI" announcement touting her April 2023 bill,[ Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act](https://substack.com/redirect/b537dc96-3b17-412f-8e66-ea2a16666afb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). On closer examination, the "protection" of women and girls is really another way to slam transgender people who wish to compete in sports. Said Stefanik in April 2023: "It is a winning issue across America - standing up for the future of women and girls." She forgot to mention what she was falsely claiming to champion women and girls in an effort to attack human rights and trans rights.
As recently as June, 2024, NY-21's Elise Stefanik was pushing her [E-PAC to support Conservative women](https://substack.com/redirect/b537dc96-3b17-412f-8e66-ea2a16666afb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Nice going. Let's get a few more Stepford Stefaniks in Congress to sync, sister-like, in the swamp.
All of that veneer -- designed to make us think she supports women -- is scratched, shattered, and pulled back while Stefanik remains mute on Trump's verbal assault on Harris and Clinton.
Stefanik's silence on the grotesque and offensive remarks from her party's leader are just as offensive to women as Trump's blustering. A true woman leader would surely find the moral compass to speak out in response to Donald Trump's moral degradation and childish tirades.
Let women take note: Elise Stefanik remained silent on the most gruesome, gender-based attack on the nation's first woman Vice President. Let all NY-21 voters take note: Elise Stefanik only speaks up when it serves to benefit her mentor, Donald Trump.
The voters of NY-21 see through Stefanik's mind-numbing double standard. Come hell or high water, when it comes to looking out for women, Stefanik will choose Trump over anyone or anything.

As a leader in the State Legislature, Tobias helped pass full-day kindergarten for all Oregon kids and strengthened the state’s rainy-day funds. He brought a pragmatic and common sense approach to policymaking. This is the kind of experienced leadership he will bring to the Secretary of State’s office — but he won’t win this November without this team, and he won’t win if he can’t hit his fundraising goals. So please, rush $20 or any amount that makes sense for you right now to help elect an experienced, dependable leader as Secretary of State. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” | [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=29587710ec58427ab028f682876f728f&_e=nLHx8vdoNaJebWf1cjXsvkICbQ9x_fEWYGKxpdutLL-PxZr36_KBiqI1ar0rofykhMr065E_hxYLYqRYseB7_n12SnHagqudL0VU9Wg88EGwoeF25T1Vb5d2cFIaLA9d3KuSJz0AVRxITbrVvLDR4Q8uxBTxklo9jfiQLedyT2vA5OG5fFvmsjmtEWKaCKD5lHtWoEbirgY9Mf_o--v0SSrxtvMkXJrsvsDOEqd36gICswz9rmmli1zTb4JOeTjXChKH7ogfqAB1y-eddLnjq3cjU52ppmKZG9Z09bcTDboMp88two94sEP4awRYOgLXWq3dbHEA-6qSAN5YRQ0BHqnE59PemkK247Pk5CfsiEz_aHGWwx9h6txwhOxIsX6kbRLKjcIXmD2GTvrTERD4o8aIRGOdKj8FvVUjYFhnInQ%3D)

---
Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=29587710ec58427ab028f682876f728f&_e=nLHx8vdoNaJebWf1cjXsvkICbQ9x_fEWYGKxpdutLL-PxZr36_KBiqI1ar0rofykhMr065E_hxYLYqRYseB7_n12SnHagqudL0VU9Wg88EGwoeF25T1Vb5d2cFIaLA9d3KuSJz0AVRxITbrVvLDR4Q8uxBTxklo9jfiQLedyT2vA5OG5fFvmsjmtEWKaCKD5lHtWoEbirgY9Mf_o--v0SSrxtvMkXJrsvsDOEqd36gICswz9rmmli1zTb4JOeTjXChKH7ogfqAB1y-eddLnjq6t1liOAPJu1rehJEXoy5v_IMX_KNGTuUyu4Llr72TN-cSddyVtoTe8iT6KBD2JHn7wAp0SIidz6XkeZUaHaZlfZkeCFhM9BMitlK4J6NnaRSV2YinXt91p21LjVSzK_rlxBoZNTfBZGjo-M3K1A1Sc%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=29587710ec58427ab028f682876f728f&_e=nLHx8vdoNaJebWf1cjXsvkICbQ9x_fEWYGKxpdutLL-PxZr36_KBiqI1ar0rofykhMr065E_hxYLYqRYseB7_n12SnHagqudL0VU9Wg88EGwoeF25T1Vb5d2cFIaLA9d3KuSJz0AVRxITbrVvLDR4Q8uxBTxklo9jfiQLedyT2vA5OG5fFvmsjmtEWKaCKD5lHtWoEbirgY9Mf_o--v0SSrxtvMkXJrsvsDOEqd36gICswz9rmmli1zTb4JOeTjXChKH7ogfqAB1y-eddLnjq8pTB1kFA7OAMuJzXncCzHA4U9YkcV0pIHPmavyIC0GdYkQdN-uF1IkVdK2pOcmPwXvOSS4Jcnwie6nBo_9BtBkwYAQoa-QJII1Zr6My5UBP08Hi8XkMbQ8mjRKi37EjQI8bA9BlDbxwsQ8G9DwuK88%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

Peter,

As August comes to a close, we’re fast approaching our [**critical end-of-month fundraising deadline**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=f00450332aa14d1dbd0256cba4d99081&_e=d-QRBhWIIY_r7M-2EXWOaOyiNHPF7OnB-AYWTNHfZleA5S4-uphwLWKVOj1z0mYJJJOPPGOUYv-WFJdwdopD_wlbsf0wBPxex-yXm8knGJ-7AciQAbjKtMjk-kKdawEUQwoKnkmMFBi1RD-By38tiN0xQDePcz3T5K8GScbRSXtuPqApiRCOBOLkOum8jItWpmQGsO7lxMFPmJtbj4kunDFosaYEUEC0AGM2O6qhF4K3BDYBvMn-54KgErks8ZNArFVrNuOnVcFMemCoSAUq1rv1d3MHql25aUgfMXM6vSXRUd4Scy64LEVGv9euLABHhQXf1a96PXTw1MLDbrbefs7S9rECxHz5IBtf_bvzzUwR_D2NWnLu-kIkIPp8mk4R), and we need your support now more than ever.

_**This race isn’t just about flipping a seat – it’s about firing Martin Heinrich and bringing real change to Washington.**_ Martin Heinrich has overstayed his welcome in Washington, and he’s lost touch with the needs and values of hardworking New Mexicans. Thanks to far-left liberals like Martin Heinrich, families can barely afford to put food on the table and are terrified for their safety thanks to the wide-open borders in our backyard.

[**We can’t afford six more years of his failed leadership.**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=f00450332aa14d1dbd0256cba4d99081&_e=d-QRBhWIIY_r7M-2EXWOaOyiNHPF7OnB-AYWTNHfZleA5S4-uphwLWKVOj1z0mYJJJOPPGOUYv-WFJdwdopD_wlbsf0wBPxex-yXm8knGJ-7AciQAbjKtMjk-kKdawEUQwoKnkmMFBi1RD-By38tiN0xQDePcz3T5K8GScbRSXtuPqApiRCOBOLkOum8jItWpmQGsO7lxMFPmJtbj4kunDFosaYEUEC0AGM2O6qhF4KO33jcLXARINJxCMGnGsJS-l6KNu843MhoHfuel6SKX31Jx8dxPoOEwiHEstrAkzeD6hC3Hk8JmflAP53VO8xsZ06LDd74b-bnTMWeO-PpUbhDC6mmbtyQfVBk1vX_GLf5gkXAVte9kmOWM6IQiUE5)

[**_ STAND WITH TEAM NELLA » _**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=f00450332aa14d1dbd0256cba4d99081&_e=d-QRBhWIIY_r7M-2EXWOaOyiNHPF7OnB-AYWTNHfZleA5S4-uphwLWKVOj1z0mYJJJOPPGOUYv-WFJdwdopD_wlbsf0wBPxex-yXm8knGJ-7AciQAbjKtMjk-kKdawEUQwoKnkmMFBi1RD-By38tiN0xQDePcz3T5K8GScbRSXtuPqApiRCOBOLkOum8jItWpmQGsO7lxMFPmJtbj4kunDFosaYEUEC0AGM2O6qhF4I2OzBioAOYodB7pzgXbw6idVvrDPZ3tWga6JYpKAg3goU6KeCCOlt00JHceD-XzJhHT6XxKR2ZWrlsjLPHgv8-wj9CoNegCF7YE0JnUgK2QzoAJZ9lW6SMEhs4dWvvWQO3QkWH80wmrvNEZD_aOflg)
_**Nella Domenici is the strong, fresh voice New Mexico desperately needs right now**_ – [**_and you have a chance to help get her elected!_**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=f00450332aa14d1dbd0256cba4d99081&_e=d-QRBhWIIY_r7M-2EXWOaOyiNHPF7OnB-AYWTNHfZleA5S4-uphwLWKVOj1z0mYJJJOPPGOUYv-WFJdwdopD_wlbsf0wBPxex-yXm8knGJ-7AciQAbjKtMjk-kKdawEUQwoKnkmMFBi1RD-By38tiN0xQDePcz3T5K8GScbRSXtuPqApiRCOBOLkOum8jItWpmQGsO7lxMFPmJtbj4kunDFosaYEUEC0AGM2O6qhF4LBxtecwZzr7ndAmr6Gb9wZD8zRmG-nnzhX0T8A4pPMP0fKgcTv5DVXF0fzQLOqm7-2sjVPftxE7LqJ0G_0oeMKf-Z-o8umruLCmffH_VVUWkjBfec-erkF2iMxS2ud4oChDgyv93oTwLc8efdpUTYi)

Our campaign team is working tirelessly on the ground, connecting with voters across the state and spreading Nella’s message of change. We’re hearing from so many New Mexicans who are ready for a fresh voice in Washington – someone who understands our struggles and is committed to fighting for us.

Heinrich and the Democrats are desperate to hang on to this seat, but with Nella’s leadership and this campaign's unwavering dedication, this seat is more competitive for Republicans than ever before!

[**We need your help before our fundraising deadline on Saturday to ensure these efforts can continue to finally flip New Mexico RED.**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=f00450332aa14d1dbd0256cba4d99081&_e=d-QRBhWIIY_r7M-2EXWOaOyiNHPF7OnB-AYWTNHfZleA5S4-uphwLWKVOj1z0mYJJJOPPGOUYv-WFJdwdopD_wlbsf0wBPxex-yXm8knGJ-7AciQAbjKtMjk-kKdawEUQwoKnkmMFBi1RD-By38tiN0xQDePcz3T5K8GScbRSXtuPqApiRCOBOLkOum8jItWpmQGsO7lxMFPmJtbj4kunDFosaYEUEC0AGM2O6qhF4LDJ0Lft9J2GhIp3OIS8ab2qSU1HEtkgcIJlhc_0RKMxMaAkYI0QXz8Y01Pc9y2Hw4mwsKFhAQ4isDw7Pwjf2j6rB6Wsdt6OoPrDIJ9JR0qczwWj3QyktPaQIT3i-97WALVXSoET_vUR5CRz5exyKqp)

Thank you for taking swift action,

Team Nella

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

| Good evening. I hope you are doing well. Because tomorrow is the California Democratic Party’s first fundraising deadline since the Democratic National Convention, I’m working late to tabulate our final figures and see how far off from our original goal we’re likely to land. | Friend,

I recently had a meeting with my finance director and the reality of the situation is a bit alarming.

After a fantastic effort from this team in July, grassroots fundraising has slowed down rapidly. That’s bad news, especially just after a quarter where our celebrity GOP opponent outraised us by $1.2 million.

Tomorrow, we will hit our critical end-of-month fundraising deadline, which will set the tone for our campaign's capacity to get out the vote with less than 70 days until the election. name: Elizabeth Nader
subject: School board leaves kids at risk – and more Spiller drama
body:
Peter, As our kids get ready to head back to school next week, we have an expectation that they’ll be safe when they walk thr
|
---
| Peter, As our kids get ready to head back to school next week, we have an expectation that they’ll be safe when they walk through the school doors. At least that’s our hope. And thinking of them being unsafe at school is one of our worst fears. As a mom of four, I know. If someone does do our children harm, can we trust our school boards to hold them accountable? You would think so. But apparently not. In this horrifying story out of Camden, the School Advisory Board President Wasim Muhammad is refusing to resign after he was accused of sexually assaulting a Middle School student in the 1990’s. I’ll spare you the details, but the accusations are pretty evil. He and the district both refuse to admit wrongdoing. Parents are rightly fired up and [made their voices heard](https://xtz223.keap-link008.com/v2/click/40c9f493731b6b644fb177aa48eb3110/eJyNkEFPAjEQhf9Lz1saFsVkb4QQslnkYPRshnaUxtI206nLSva_W8Bw0sTbzPR7b_rmJBg9eG6NaMSRv-p6JipBqG206HkZPIO-vNb3d9PZtBLO-o81hRxFc_pVfAMuqvmsrgQPEQvy_LRYdu12_bppt10hI1DZ8T-fh3p-81k9LtqNGMc_jfFgefVZvJNomDKeExlbUvELucLvmWNqlOr7fsIQrecw8ciKQ--T0nAw6FUquA2lR5M1nEsFxFY7TCpSYEwcKEkXsnGD1HtwDv07yqtcJr0PwcldADIyEiZbpiyTJORMXsIbI8mExwxOwi4nlEwWXPk-xIje_Ny-w-EaYvwGO1uTvA==) in this past Thursday’s meeting. The GASLIGHTING [response](https://xtz223.keap-link008.com/v2/click/c14b419d81bd98575d0dcca7da729a63/eJyNkEFrwkAQhf_LnJOmSdRCoBQRkRDrQdqzTHYHujXZXXYnba3kvzu14slCD3MY5r3v8eYITBYt1xoq-OLvoighgUDKeEOWF84yqvO1mE7yMk-gM3a_Cm7wUB1vmq-Cs2tWThLggyeRvGzni6berHbretOI0mOQjP9xHorZlbN8ntdrGMc_wdQbXn4IO0LFYaCfRtpIK34NnejfmH2sssy-5_f59E65PlPYa7Jp6zDo1AeKRlZOUakhkk4xRhw6zp44oNq3Mo_8aZgp7HrXmo4kFb0nqy8va-jwmz2eAGXtdlY=) of Superintendent McCombs? “We are confident that, together, we can overcome these challenges and create a thriving environment for everyone in our district." Even Muhammad’s wife, who was an alleged participant in his abuse, tried to claim that the “success” of the district under his leadership should cause people to calm down about his horrible crimes. Talk about PR spin and damage control that totally ignores the horror of this situation. The lesson for us as Common Sense New Jerseyans concerned about our kids? We can’t trust those in power to be looking out for them or to hold bad apples accountable. We’re going to have to get loud and force them to do it – and then double down on our vigilance to protect. It’s the sad truth.
---
|
---
| **TWEET (or Facebook) this:
Putting politics and power over our kids’ safety is the definition of lunacy – and evil. Time for accountability. The lesson?
We can’t trust the powerful to protect our kids. [https://nj1015.com/camden-board-president-accused-assault/?trackback=twitter_mobile ](https://xtz223.keap-link008.com/v2/click/e8f2321009427e2f5a7914b185d8cbd9/eJyNkEFLw0AQhf_LnBNjElshIKWUUkJqD0XPZbI70LXJ7rI7UWvJf-9YRS8KPcxhmPe-x5sTMFm0XGuo4J0_iqKEBAIp4w1ZXjjLqC7XYnKXl3kCnbGHVXCDh-r0p_lHcHFNy2kCfPQkkqftfNHUm9VuXW8aUXoMknEd57745Swf5_UaxvFfMPWGl6_CjlBxGOizkTbSip9DJ_o9s49VltmX_Daf3CjXZwp7TTZtHQad-kDRyMopKjVE0inGiEPH2YwDqkMr88BvhpnCrnet6UhS0Xuy-vtlDR2_ssczZ-12WA==)**

---
|
---
| Next in the ongoing saga of the powerful abusing our education system for their own gain... There’s more to the Sean Spiller story over at NJEA. _(ICYMI our earlier reporting, check it out[here](https://xtz223.keap-link008.com/v2/click/e3aaadf7c7c72f7ff4511c083d95fba0/eJyNkEFrwzAMhf-Lz_FCk60buZVSSkjXw9jOQ3FE4taRjS2XZSX_fW43etpgoIvQ0_f0dBaMBMR1JyrxwZ9FUYpMeFTaaSReW2JQ12nxcL8oF5kwmo5bb6MT1fnX5ZvgurUsnzLBk8MkeX1ZrZt6v33f1fsmKR345PE_zmOxvHE2z6t6J-b5TzCOmjenxA6iYh_xkqjTKRW_eZP0A7MLVZ4rO46WAqZSJrZ31vc5HRAktDFgkIygBvSyi5fGyhbo6K0xMgzQTTI4bQz6IHt7kgpGB7qnPPmDc0jdz_ManL6vmL8AjM56zA==)). _ Using NJEA letterhead, in a mailing to members, Sean Spiller announced his campaign for Governor and solicited support. This letter is signed under his official title as NJEA President. We got our hands on a copy of the letter, thanks to an eagle-eyed Common Sense New Jerseyan, which we will share with you below.
---
|
---
| This is fraud at worst, and a major disservice to teachers at best. What an abuse of the office and the resources of this organization that is supposed to be serving the teachers who pay part of their hard earned salary into it, but is instead being used to bolster and bankroll Spiller’s political ambitions. What a sham.

---
|
---
| **TWEET (or Facebook) this:
Have you seen? @SpillerforNJ used official @NJEA letterhead to mail members about his campaign and solicit support. What a waste of teachers’ precious resources. These dollars should be going to help our teachers, not bankroll Spiller’s political ambitions.
#ItsCommonSense **

---
|
---
| Friends, it’s a full time job sometimes calling out all this madness. But someone else needs to do it. Because these “leaders” will keep getting away with it until they are called out regularly and publicly. So thank you, Common Sense Majority, for doing your part. We’re making progress. Elizabeth Nader
President
Common Sense Club _P.S. [Become a Common Sense Club Member](https://xtz223.keap-link008.com/v2/click/187236407d49711c0cc90da8c0c83e6e/eJyNkMsKglAQht9l1pJ47ALuRETEahG1Di9DHvJcOI6Rie_eycJVQTC7-f5v-GcAQplLSisI4E4PxnxwwGDJNUdJkZKUl9OWrZae7znQcHlNjOo0BMPX8AxMqfWSOUC9RoscD2GUpfvkvE33mSV1buyN_zwbtp498S5MtzCOP8UoOMU3624hINPhq1HFbSs6mcbyNZFuA9ctlRBKtminbLpioczFFSgKNG3NtWtNudYoq88bMuzfvvEJr1lmZQ==) today and we’ll get you on that call! _

subject: Nigel Bristow - Campaign Update! PLEASE SHARE!
body:
*📢 Nigel Bristow for Congress: Campaign Update*

*🗳️ North Carolina is Officially in Play!*

Last week, Nigel Bristow had the honor of attending the Democratic National
Convention to nominate Vice President Kamala Harris as our party's
presidential nominee. Our campaign is fully committed to helping Kamala win
in November and carrying out her agenda in Congress.

*🌟 Endorsed by MomsRising*

We’re proud to announce that Nigel Bristow has earned the prestigious Child
Care Seal of Approval from MomsRising, the nation’s leading organization of
over one million mothers and their families. This endorsement highlights
Nigel’s commitment to addressing the critical child care challenges facing
families in our district and across the country.

*🗓️ Early Voting Starts October 17th*

Remember, November 5th is not just Election Day—it's your *LAST CHANCE *to
vote! We encourage everyone to make a plan to vote as early as possible.
Early voting begins on *October 17th*, and we need you to bring at least*
three friends with you to the polls.* Let’s ensure that every voice in our
district is heard.

*📅 Upcoming Events in Chatham County – September 21st*

Join us for two exciting events on September 21st, hosted by the Chatham
County Democratic Party:

-

*11:00 AM:* Chatham County Democratic Party Community Engagement Center
*Location:* 628-A East Street, Pittsboro, NC 27312
-

*3:00 PM:* NC Arts Incubator
*Location:* 223 N Chatham Ave, Siler City, NC 27344

*We’re thrilled to announce that Rep. Wiley Nickel will be joining us for
the 3:00 PM event! Come meet Nigel, discuss the issues that matter to you,
and learn how you can get involved in this crucial election.*

*RSVP for the Events Here:* *Sign Up to Attend*
<https://www.mobilize.us/chathamcountydems/event/671665/>

*🎯 Get Involved, Make a Difference*

This election is one of the most important of our lifetime. Let’s work
together to make sure North Carolina helps Kamala Harris and Nigel Bristow
secure victories in November.

*💪 Help Us Flip the 9th District*

We are launching a special fundraising challenge. We’re looking for 99
supporters to donate $99 to help us flip the 9th District. Your
contribution will go directly toward powering our grassroots campaign and
ensuring we have the resources to reach every voter.

*Donate $99 to Flip the 9th
<https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nigel-bristow-for-congress-1?refcode=directory>*

Let’s make history together—every dollar counts in the fight for a brighter
future.

*Stay Connected*
Visit *Nigel Bristow for Congress*
<https://www.nigelbristowforcongress.com/> for more information on upcoming
events, volunteer opportunities, and how you can contribute to our
campaign. Together, we can bring positive change to North Carolina’s 9th
District.

Thank you for your support, everyone! It means the world to me. We've got a
real chance to shock the world in November but I'm going to need all of
your help to do it. So please, please, please, keep your foot on the
gas. *Share
this email with every Democrat you know and let's win this thing. Because
when we fight, we win!*

See you all soon!

Nigel

PS - Here are some pics from the convention. Truly an honor getting to
represent NC AND nominate Vice President Harris. Can't wait to carry out
her agenda in Congress.

**Good Morning**! On this day in 1888, Mary Ann Nichols, the first known victim of London's "[Jack the Ripper](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DGPtCAQgOFfgx1GRli0oPgau_3aKw0Lwzp7uBqYaPz3l7tcefVTvMn7cZ_vnjK9n__9io7TNvvAdOA8yF5J0LNuokuIgH2DTlkwSoG20CzOmmDH1AccjHnAYPBmkzGPMFrl4y0NDTnoQHdDr1TXWWXaOFoPRqdxUDFG-xC6w0i8lfa10ZsXTPnaDixt2NYmu4V5r6L_J2ASMJ3n2S5UeSvXtwuYeKEqo78kveWvCJhePnxKXlAW2ncsMmRPa5WJSmV5UGBam-LiflLOVG9W6O65eso_Uf57weHgKwAA__8kC2Ao)," was discovered murdered in the city's Whitechapel district, starting the infamous mystery of the killer's true identity. A few weeks ago, we reported on a "[mega rattlesnake den](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL_G3ojgDMYMDF2ypWtH6zBHchU2lqFO-_dVOnd9b3l6H7f5hpx5u7_jSr6lMuPS-KR5EoMSoGfdR5-IgIaevLJglAJtoX_4kJRTCVJyDkZpLMZFjmZMyRoJYaSePUjQchqUktIqc4nOIhid3KRijDZ0WlLkVo7LZ-GtPSjln3LScVnK2mf_aG2v3fDWwbWDK-4bPetLdXA9OVJ5wY1XzFUsJZcDYxErfoujBDpaFRU3kb-4ihK47kUsmDmVY2MUOgaD1gQtFerRyRDILs4MDuQUEcf-8HF_cs5cR9tpeV-R819W-3_S6eE3AAD__xsaaXU)" in Colorado. ## Harris Interview Draws Mixed Reviews
Reviews of Vice President Kamala Harris' [first sit down interview](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFytCAURp8GOx24gmhB8Td0-7cpHYTrehOEHWR1Nk-f2dTpv_nOmfNxm2-OIqX7f7ejqWuena904jy2vWhBzrIJZkUE7Bs0QoMSAqSGZjNiXAe-BNUrsahhmpYglXOIYuwXvyI2ZICD5GMvBOdaqC5M2oGS6zSKEIJemOQYqObSfWZKdcM1vvKJpfN5b6LZan0crP_HwDKw13V1z8PVHNzrPWBgj5rLi4HND0qUEwPrc3zuiY7KwL7hDCwfGdieM7CbK4WO9nLxu_UptZQqlpPwaqPzX63zPj9TdQtFqu9brTif1DByrhnYppjwuChGOgbNJL_vjuKvaf2722ngJwAA__8UKW8C) since becoming the Democratic nominee have been mixed, with one publication stating she left voters with "more questions than answers" Thursday night. During a 30-minute interview with CNN's Dana Bash, Harris, accompanied by her running mate, Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz, emphasized that her "[values have not changed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFuhDAQAF9jOqPdxWAoXKShu7QpkQ8vxyYGTsbCSl4fXep0I00xmo_bdPMSZX-8-41dXo7Jz1kunnrdoCYzmSq4hZm4qdihpRaRjKVqdRYNwGABG4SuCwQNdvPMLSF0CH6oxBGQgb5BBLDY1mGwnlqzDD2GEOxdGeAg-Uj15yF7XnmJ38fFqZ6PrYpuzfl5quZN0ahoLKXU8_3cuZwvr2h8oaLxy28-er36lOTUWTZdfPzR875r2TOnS7goGqvkwrNIjHJ2Vhl4bF7iXyn__305-g0AAP__iH5Z5w)" despite several policy shifts. She also mentioned that she would be open to appointing a Republican to her Cabinet. A columnist from The New York Times found the interview to be "[vague" and "vacuous](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DHv0zAQBfBP42xX2WcnaQcPRSgD0p8FJMbIxJfmwLEj20konx61M9OT3pve78fH-OE4cHx8dSvZOqfRTZUPGq-gFaAZTePtTISkG7Kqx1YpND02i0Wkrr3NSnYOJ9OplvpZmVunO-3xKk3DFiUaedVKSdmr9uJvvcPWzLer8t73P4WR5LmmfPmVONaF5vBMB-XLlNYm2KXWrQh9FzgIHM7zvKwlvjaBA0XYi8Ah0vmKLQWuPL2bJ1ReqcCUwr5GLhWKexY43GMnONy0p73Ab7e64GBxOXMBjpXywXSCZw8xVVgobLBQFji4DPe72r78_fNd6CFN7IX-_OlFRmf5RnlrsvXbySFw6Xph5GN1HN4f6v9FD4v_AgAA__8Xt3qy)," stating that Harris avoided giving straight answers and stuck to "flimsy" talking points. Other outlets praised the interview, saying Harris came across as warm, relatable, and likable.
## Grocery Chain to End Tobacco Sales
Stop & Shop, an East Coast grocery chain with 360 stores, [will end sales of tobacco products](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtuKyEUAL8GOiw4gGELiitdbee0KVc8DoYIL6uFOMrfR06dekZTzPttu_na6n5_8w90M_fNx1mfuFkmBQO1KZpcRgSUFJ0woIUAZYAWF5NYrAyL1dwICdlqz4NIhicbcwieVgccFLdSCM6N0Je0GA9a5cWKlJIJRHFMdfbz8tHrPgvm9t2feF5if9DmypzHIPIfgZXAOguW2tqLEVjD56g7jkFgVVZrba5szH6wUfrBcE-DzR58jJ0N3_ClEbnOcGIm8n856OnS8VVbq-NqiOL3h6-_aTr_nvB08BMAAP__CaFeOg) today, citing community wellness and other major retailers like Walmart, CVS, and Target with similar policies. The grocery chain has joined forces with the American Cancer Society and will organize [cigarette buyback events](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7Fu7CAQheGngY4VDPjiLShu427TprTGMNhE2CCDHOXtI0cpU3_FOf_7a35hyulY33An12OZ0fd00TwKrQSY2fDgIhGQ5uSUhUEpMBb45mghDwoXRYSgRx0pGPI2GBvlczDIkwMJRo5aKSmtGh7haREGE5-jCiHYhRlJIfVyPj5KOvpGMX-Vi86HLzvPbuu9Nqb_M5gYTK2XikdoW6m3M5gqrtR-ReARxG2intSaOCkTNhK9LOh9EfcTfrpQP1POqf2zzMh1x5R_tvrf5ZeD7wAAAP__Oodcnw) to encourage customers to quit. Stop & Shop stated that the transition to being tobacco-free would discourage youngsters from smoking and enhance public health. Stop & Shop's new policy arrived as [a new poll showed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL8GNkdwYGMPDF28pWtH6wJHuIqYyMau8vdVOnd-em94X9flilx4vX_ig3xLdcHQ-KRl7IzuwC5WRp-IgIwkrx30WoN1ILMfUQ0mwQRDvDnjTEgTOnKJlCYEHSR7UGDVaLRWyun-EieH0Ns0jTrG6G7CKorc6nb5rry2TKm86knbJdSHLD639tyF-RAwC5hbpsylvJmA-VkLh5eAOROWlgNuJGC2Y98PPXQB1xVvvHcZSzkCr_VOa3fs1O3HdtLbk5uPzx8uhffBCavuD-S_uGz_bzg9_AYAAP__EAxf0Q) that cannabis and hallucinogen use remains high among adults 19-30 and 35-50, with 42% of younger adults using cannabis in 2023.
## College Football Preview
It's the first full weekend of the [2024 college football season](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFurDAQRb_GdEbjwWAoXLzG3b42JRrsMTgx6xU4i_bvo02d6jZXOkfn4zbfKOV0X__TzrbGMpOv6cnzKDslUc-6CTYyI3cNW2WwVwq1wWazk5pIBdC0TIw-4miAogkI_eC7hVWTLAJqGDulAIzq2zAZwl7HaVQhBLMIDRxSLUf7WdK9bhzzqzz5aH3Zm2y3Wh-n6P4JdALddV3t90m1BHq9DwLdWcvxeu-jHPUU6O6eKAp0b65AB6NA14FA50vOvLKMpdSFcpYr7XzKWuRF1W_yYv6SSqAzeho6AwOAEeiaw4bHlXJO52CEhnWnlH_t6t-tnhZ_AgAA___Uy2jH), and a lot has changed since Michigan won the national championship. Alabama coach Nick Saban retired, Jim Harbaugh departed for the NFL, and conference realignments have resulted in [new teams joining](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGuozAQAL_GdEb2YsdQuLiGLtdeiRa8hr04bBQsUP7-lKtfOZpmNH_u0x258L7-xifFmmXCpfJJU687q8FNrkkxEwF1DUUbwFsLLkCzRULbDxnB-5Rn8DdnbLJovAmdMW7BhiMYcKbvrDUmWN-mISB4l4feppTCrJyhxFXe7V_hvW6Uy0dOereLPJsSt1pfh-p-KRgVjNd1tVUSfr5WwXhyIlEwLlIKraSzSJ2xFH0QHrLrBy-PQ0vO-uK66SL1S3rmVS8b7isdGmzfGed7OwTfvGN6XVwKH7egnFmfyOV_SP15yxnhXwAAAP__HRdknA) the Big Ten, Big 12, ACC, and the SEC. Today's early game has No. 14 Clemson facing No. 1 Georgia, and the afternoon matchup between No. 19 Miami and Florida is always interesting. The top late game features No. 7 Notre Dame taking on No. 20 Texas A&M. And there's still No. 23 USC versus No. 13 LSU on Sunday. ## Dallas Shooting Results in Policeman's Death
A Dallas [police officer was killed](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1uwyAURp_G3ojg8j8wdMmWrh2tC1xiJBIsGyXp21fJ3vHTpyMdnZ_LcsHa6v36jTcK41X6gmnUBy2OScFALWrOIfLsxUxBWNCCG-_kvAbS0iOkLKWDpDEmrZF7MtFZ65NOcw3AQXEnheDaSH2iCMaWKIyTToFwk-KU6-j7aaw06IVHab_9Qfsp9dvcwjrGdkzya4LzBGfc7vQ83td77KOmRhOcM7aGB_vgbOutJmIFBzZ2rL2Per-yYiWiT4brqEDGjJTIGFE8WFSm4LyHvD1ra_UwdlL8esPaPg7jnySPAH8BAAD__7TTYyQ) and two more wounded after exchanging gunfire with a suspect who was also fatally shot. Police [responded to a call](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFv8yAUAH-NvWHBA2M8MHxLtnxrRwvDI34NMZGhJv33VbN3v9NJ93Fdro4S7bf_7oG2vmJenK904mKYFAzUovpgVx5m0aMVE4yC69nIfrOao58D536etFYSVoMzIqoIqzST5z1Z4KC4kULwUctxwBX0FFehjTQKhOkUx0A1H0PdsOLLlZi-84nH4POjT3ar9Vk6-a-DSweX1tqwYysN8f4LdHB5Oyy4lFxhZcu50n5jz5zII8sxkseD3SklDKy2zGj__DowMDErPYqxP2x4NkqJip46xW8PR-ndrn-sOC38BAAA__8YfGIi) late Thursday night from an officer in distress, whom they found with a gunshot wound in a marked police car when they arrived on the scene. Two of the responding officers were shot before the suspect led police on a highway chase that ended in the suspect's death. Dallas Mayor Eric Johnson called the shooting "devastating" and said, "[Dallas has lost a hero.](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGurCAURb8GOgwcGAYKitfYzWtvaVAOSoJihKjz9zcz_e12sbNWsn5ew8unnLb5v1_RtTuWwU8tnTgYJgUDNSga3MiDFRSdeMJDcG2NpItTERFGbb02OihQXEhhbUCpI_BgA00OOChupBD8oeWjwxH0M45CG2kUCEMUx5BaObq2YMPb15jf5cSjm8pKs1ta2yuR_wj0BPrrurpYbrXhVT8HAv1nEuiDz9lXtpecJmR1KaWlbWZTam_2xbKMPuBR2YF-avRwYb9SzqnqJ1F8Xn3KX2X7o8Dp4DcAAP__fKJfYQ)"
## NASA Awards Houston Company Lunar Landing
NASA [awarded Intuitive Machines](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LHSnCAUxfGnwQ4HLqhYUKSx-9KmdBCuygyCI3d19-0zmz71aX7n_-dn_nExxbz9dgdaeq9ldp7ijbPhSnLQs26CXUQYZYNWDtBJ0Y9GNbtFH7QC4Rdt9GrcGpYljOuA0OGousE10YIALYySUnS96lpcoB_WRfZGGQ3SMC0wRCpXSzsSvl1d06fceLW-HE2yO9FZmfrFYGIwPc_TXvgivOp3ZzAR-j2XVLYPg6meziODKWZ6xe8Dfji_x4yVb0iVS9mP_EiZZ1cd9yXT5TzxgCneeH34UUquvJYX7fwsCfkXz4XhMDKYmsuG84kpxdoPTIvtcDH9Y9J_qt0W_gYAAP__ni1w-g) of Houston a $116.9 million contract to deliver six payloads to the moon's south pole in 2027. The lunar [south pole is notorious](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD2TgyAUAH8NdjiPD5UUFNfY5dornac8IjMoGUBN_v1Nrr9yu939uU93DDHsj2_cyNaXTxMuNZw0Ga4El3rSjbMzuJtoyIpBdgL6m1HNaj0Y3Xl_66CToMTge1oEEOjZkQMjmmAlSA1GCQFdr7qWZtkPfha9UUZLYZgGcqGm3NaVKr2w-PhOJ-V2SVsT7VrrszD1xeTI5HhdV7tjwfaRTibHna7CM0XCQh_EghwvzK7wsNcjfCL4hssadio8HjtmXtJRV_5MkXimQpiXlTuK4aT8ZnJssnXPK8QYSj8wDY8NQ_xzqf-sOa38DQAA__9ucWik) for rugged terrain and frigid temperatures and its [water-richness](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0jz1vwyAUAH-NvWHBAwMZGLpkS9eO1jPg-El8RIHa6b-v0r3zDXf3dVtuSInK_RNzdP211QV9pyMulknBQC1qDG7l4SLG6ISBWXB9sXLcnfFcS49y9RcEROGVCXKbhV-VjsHDSA44KG6lEHzWcp7iCtpsq9BWWgXCDorHQL0-p77HHl_YtvRTj_icfM1jcnvvjzbIjwGuA1zP85zaA3180wGuBRsyKv2b3r0so9-pxMZyrYVlao1qYcDBjE8XHielRE2bQfF7Rkp_iv7P8eHgNwAA__8fPFml) is especially of interest to scientists. Intuitive Machines made headlines in February as the first commercial company to softly land on the moon. They are now in the final assembly phase of their second lunar mission, with plans to deliver the lander to the launch facility later this year.
## AI Scam Nearly Entraps Texas Mom
Amanda Murphy of Bryan, TX, was nearly [tricked into wiring $3,000](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOhCAYhJ8GOwz8KGBBcY3dXnulAfldyeFigNPde_qL218zmWQmk8n3dZtuNsTwuH_aDU19Lmmycw0HTpoKTqGbusYbx_zAGzRcQc-ZHLRoVuOGXs5-Ed7PqpNOLQwlDMBmqYR1CptggEHHtOCc9VL0LTqQanFcaqE74Jp0DH2oKbd1xYpPW5b4Sgfmdk5bE81a616I-CAwEhjP82y_XX1eIYHx2iYwMn35S2ygZbYbjWgPLNTll33QLdUVM63Z_my2hl_0dE07Flpqyi-6YtwLfXcKgbHJxu9niDEUqUjH7psN8X2m_sPmMPAXAAD__wpbZtU) to a scammer who used artificial intelligence to impersonate her daughter, suggesting she had been kidnapped. Murphy went to a Walmart to wire the funds as ransom, where an associate was able to get her daughter on the phone and expose the scam. The FBI warns this type of ploy is becoming more common as AI sophistication grows.

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Mississippi votes conservative. Are we going to see more conservative policies?
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/educationstandards-11573011?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend, Waiting for my suitcase in the arrivals hall at Jackson airport the other evening, it occurred to me that the luggage carrousel was a pretty good metaphor for Mississippi politics.

**Like suitcases on a carrousel, many leaders simply sit on the conveyor belt of state politics, waiting their turn to get moved along to the next role.**
---
|
---
_Suitcases on a conveyor belt: not much charisma_
|
**Too often leaders are carried along by time and process, rarely offering any vision as to what our state should do differently. **

**This explains why Mississippi conservatives have achieved less in 12 years than Arkansas, Louisiana and Alabama have accomplished in the past 12 months.** Louisiana did not even have a Republican governor this time last year, yet they’ve already passed universal school choice.

**Things could be about to change if House Speaker, Jason White, has his way. **

This week, White announced that he will be hosting a Tax Policy Summit on September 24th to take a deep dive into the prospects for Tax Reform. It's open to the public, and free to [register here:](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=c989caf406&e=5703353baa)

My friend, Grover Norquist, will be speaking, as will Gov Reeves, as well as Sen Jeremy England and Sen Josh Harkins, and Rep Trey Lamar and Rep Scott Bounds.
---
|
---
_Conservative leadership looks like this_
| **Having a conversation in public matters because in the past the leadership in our state Senate has done what it can to head off tax cuts.** Bringing the facts of what can and cannot be done into the open makes it far harder for anyone to keep finding new excuses to oppose actual conservative policy.

Back in 2022, Mississippi passed a law to cut the state income tax to a flat 4 percent. This $525 million tax cut, driven forward by Speaker Philip Gunn and Gov Reeves, benefited 1.2 million taxpayers and their families. **But we must not forget how some in the Senate fought against it. **

**Weak Senate leadership has a history of opposing conservative proposals in our state.**

The Senate leadership maneuvered to stop anti-DEI legislation in 2024. For three years in a row, the Senate leadership has killed off attempts to restore the ballot initiative.

Rep Rob Roberson’s excellent school funding reform bill, perhaps the only big strategic achievement of this year’s session, passed despite attempts to scupper it by some in the Senate. (Part of the deal to get the bill passed was to change its name.)

**When the Senate leadership wants to oppose an authentically conservative policy, they follow a now familiar pattern. **

A reason is cited as to why what is being proposed can’t be done. School choice, we were once told, would be unconstitutional. An anti-DEI law, it was implied, was unnecessary because there was no DEI on campus.

Once that excuse is shown to be nonsense (there is no constitutional bar to school choice, DEI is rampant on campus), another excuse is promptly conjured up. And on it goes.

Each time the Senate leadership opposes conservative policy this way, I wonder what their alternatives are. The answer is that most of the time there are none. It is not enough to oppose ideas that aren't your own.

**Eventually, of course, a suitcase that sits on the carousel for too long ends up in lost luggage. **
---
|
---
_Sad end to a long and pointless journey?_
| **As a direct consequence of the 2022 Reeves-Gunn tax cuts, Mississippi is now starting to see a flood of inward investment into the state. **Every time you hear about a new factory opening up in our state, remember who and what helped make it happen.

I am very optimistic that this Tax Summit could see further progress to make our state more competitive.

Have an awesome weekend!
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=63aba63cf1&e=5703353baa "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO

Her MAGA opponent wants to be another destructive force in the Senate, as Republicans aim to crush affordable health care, ban abortion and do nothing about the senseless gun violence Nevadans know all too well.

As a filmmaker, I've always been deeply interested in the moments that defined the American spirit — the Civil War, the Great Depression, the Second World War, the Vietnam War, the Civil Rights Movement.
#

---
Hello, Peter. This is Ken Burns.
As a filmmaker, I've always been deeply interested in the moments that defined the American spirit — the Civil War, the Great Depression, the Second World War, the Vietnam War, the Civil Rights Movement.
These were inflection points where we were forced to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
As Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
Today, we face a new generational challenge. Our system of government is in great peril. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It has never been more important that we come together to ensure that our republic endures for future generations.
To meet that challenge, we need leaders who understand how important our democracy is and what it truly means to serve. That's why I’m writing to you on behalf of Ruben Gallego. Ruben is the son of immigrant parents, the first in his family to go to college, a Marine veteran, and a father.
His opponent, Kari Lake, attacks our elections at every turn. She sows the very same discord that is tearing our country apart. She is dangerous. Where Ruben would unite us, Kari Lake seeks only division.
We need more people like Ruben serving our country, and it would mean the world to me if you could support his campaign.
[**Can you make a donation of $3 or whatever you can afford to Ruben’s campaign for U.S. Senate in Arizona? The philosophical principles of being a police officer are racist and anti-Black.” - Jenn Jackson, Assistant Professor of Political Science, Syracuse University | | Stephanie Baran, a sociology instructor at Nicholls State University, describes herself as a “** vulgar Marxist” because she desires “ to see the entire dismantling of the system versus the other, softer, kinder, brutal Marxists.” | | Robyn Henderson-Espinoza—aka Roberto Che Espinoza—is a faculty member at Duke Divinity School, offering a course about “ decolonizing ” Jesus and his “ myths and teachings that have been institutionalized. ” Columbia professor Joseph Massad called the 10/7 Hamas massacre of Israeli and American citizens "awesome." Meanwhile at Cornell, Professor of History Russell Rickford announced his “exhilaration” over the murder of innocent Israeli civilians. PragerU needs your help to make sure America's students hear the truth about our shared values and traditions that make America the greatest nation on Earth before it's too late. Many Americans allow their kids to spend hours online every day, seeing social media posts with anti-American, anti-West, anti-God messaging. We’re allowing our youth to be taught destructive ideas and lies that are ruining our country. We’re allowing them to be taught to hate America, the West, and its allies. And it shows. According to exit polls, 63% of voters ages 18 to 29 voted for leftist politicians in the 2022 midterm elections. That means a majority of Gen Z support anti-American, left-wing policies, such as socialism/Marxism, wide open borders, higher taxes, more handouts, and soft-on-crime policies. Education got us into this mess. Education is the only thing that will get us out. Millions of 14-year-olds who are in class and online today...are just a few short years away from being the decision-makers of tomorrow. Are we going to give up on our youth? Or leave it to chance that they grow up and change their mind after it is too late? Young Americans will make terrible decisions about our leaders, our national security, and our public policies if we don't invest in teaching them the truth! We must do everything in our power TODAY to save America. PragerU has identified roughly 68 million 18-29-year-olds who spend hours on social media every day. We have the content to reach them now, and with your help, we can market our pro-American ideas to a generation in desperate need of a better education. A year and a half ago, chronic disease, endless wars, censorship, and corporate control over our regulatory agencies _were barely a whisper in the national conversation_.

PRESS RELEASE—Boston, MAFOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: August 30, 2024

## ICAN Endorses Robert Antonellis for U.S. Senate in Massachusetts Republican Primary
The Israeli-American Civic Action Network (ICAN) is proud to endorse Robert Antonellis in the Republican primary for the U.S. Senate seat in Massachusetts. As a staunch advocate for the principles and values that align with our mission, Mr. Antonellis has demonstrated unwavering support for Israel, a commitment to combating antisemitism, and a dedication to upholding the U.S.-Israel alliance.
Mr. Antonellis, an accomplished software engineer and a strong conservative voice, has made it clear that his priority is to fight for America’s interests while ensuring that our closest allies, particularly Israel, are supported unequivocally. His platform includes:
* Pro-Israel Stance: Antonellis has pledged to increase U.S. foreign aid to Israel and maintain the U.S. Embassy in Jerusalem, affirming America’s steadfast commitment to the security and sovereignty of the State of Israel.
* Combating Antisemitism: He is committed to enforcing laws against antisemitic activities and promoting Holocaust education, recognizing the importance of educating the public on the dangers of hate and prejudice.
* Opposition to the BDS Movement: Antonellis opposes the Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions (BDS) movement, labeling it an “evil plan” that must be stopped to protect the economic and social ties between the U.S. and Israel.
* Preventing a Nuclear Iran: Antonellis has taken a strong stand against allowing Iran to develop nuclear capabilities, emphasizing the need for strict measures to prevent a nuclear-armed Iran.

As an organization dedicated to the empowerment of Israeli-American activists and pro-Israel Americans, ICAN believes that Robert Antonellis represents the best choice for the Republican nomination. His commitment to defending our shared values and principles aligns closely with our mission to combat antisemitism and support Israel.
“Robert Antonellis is a candidate who truly understands the importance of the U.S.-Israel alliance and the need to protect our constitutional freedoms,” said Nirit Friedlander, Co-Chair of ICAN Massachusetts. “His strong stance against antisemitism and his unwavering support for Israel make him the ideal candidate for the U.S. Senate.”
ICAN urges all Republican voters in Massachusetts to support Robert Antonellis in the upcoming primary on September 3, 2024.
The Israeli-American Civic Action Network (ICAN) is the only organization that brings together Israeli and American activists to create change for a better America, a more secure Israel, and a stronger U.S.-Israel alliance. ICAN works with community leaders, elected officials, and grassroots organizations to strengthen the bond between the United States and Israel at all levels of government through civic education, advocacy, and public engagement. It also promotes policies that support the Israeli-American community and foster mutual understanding. With a focus on policy leadership and strategic engagement, ICAN is committed to empowering Israeli-American activists and pro-Israel Americans to take an active role in shaping public policy.

Friend

The best time of year has arrived, college football season is finally here! Michigan State took the field last night and secured it's first victory under Coach Smith (congrats Coach)! Paul and his family had the chance to reflect on Paul's grandfather [Duffy Daugherty's legacy](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001NrSILdMa3QMZdZIWg1tiB16tg9Snfwc5KxSFqODYeSPY4-FVmBOkdb47mZDSeF5PCsY-XXzn5CscvXCUcgVXRTe0nVUdr_k7rcU-o7tqzGmDcaYvv3jBTSfXvo2N38CcexOMSfFXxMYE4RInXZraXKWBHYd-vd9r61U7r6v73XvL6OAwdVcBv11614jhm2Ow&c=szEWG5a24lMGt3B94XuA7t48f4VEZQ1qENqf1eTzXIeq8VGFfM483w==&ch=PZ5107_pGxgW9nO0vWIJCp6_xFg-428GHVvqQaDhTRSjyHXngppdLg==) before the game.
As a pioneer in racially integrating college football and a two-time national champion, he believed that we are stronger together when we align around a common goal. Now is the time to Unite America and West Michigan around a desire to create a safer, stronger, more prosperous country for all!
---
|
---
|
West Michiganders are tired of the same old Washington Hillary Scholten playbook of nice sounding talk and with a record of classic progressive politician party-line voting results. Team Hudson is working hard every day to ensure MI-3 returns to responsive representation focused on positive and tangible actions not platitudes and words. This has been a busy week for us.

---
|
### MIRS Monday Podcast

Paul was pleased to join MIRS on its Monday show to talk about the importance of this race, not just for West Michigan, but for control of the US House and the future of our country.

Good morning, Peter! I’ll give you a moment to grab your morning caffeine before I get into it. Today’s a big day, and I don’t want you to start your morning with another in what I’m sure are a huge pile of aggressive fundraising emails. So here’s where we’re at: Tonight at midnight marks our end-of-month fundraising deadline. It also officially brings us two months out until Election Day. Dear Peter, [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/082924mh4c]
I’ll cut straight to the chase: We're still $51,947 short of our August fundraising goal, and we're only 12 hours away, time is running out. My team just updated me on where we stand, and it's not looking good.
We’re up against a tough fight here in Oklahoma— my opponent seems to think she’s just going to skate into this seat without a challenge. Well, guess what? We’re tied in this race.
I’ve never been the kind of person to back down from a fight, especially when it’s about something that matters as much as this . My background in cybersecurity taught me that the stakes are high, and every move counts. I’ve spent my career defending our nation against threats—now, I’m fighting to bring that same resilience and strength to Congress , to protect our communities, and to ensure that Oklahoma's voice is heard loud and clear.
Peter, this campaign isn’t just about me—it’s about all of us stepping up when it matters most. The reality is, our political system rewards those who can raise the most money , not necessarily the best candidate. We have proof that Oklahomans are looking for someone different—but are we going to let Bice continue to coast?
That’s why I must ask: Can you contribute to help us reach our goal? Every dollar gets us closer to the change Oklahoma desperately needs. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aug31mail]

This campaign isn’t just about me—it’s about all of us. It’s about making sure that communities like ours aren’t left behind, that the people who feel forgotten have a voice.

subject: More than 2 million Americans have stepped up to power this fight, and I am counting on you to join them.

body:
Time is running out to reach our end-of-month goal, and I need your help. | | |
---
Peter, our campaign has had an extraordinary month, thanks in large part to supporters like you from across the country donating to Tim’s and my campaign. But, to win this November, we must keep up our momentum. We cannot sit around and hope that things will work out. Kirsten Gillibrand is Schumer's key ally in this plot, and if we don't stop them, the Democrats will have free rein to push their far-left agenda down America's throat. But with you by my side in this fight we can defeat Gillibrand on the way to delivering a Republican Senate majority that will put an end to Schumer’s plot. | | | | | Chuck Schumer is ready to ram through the Left’s extreme policies—Green New Deal, open borders, gun grabs, you name it—and without the filibuster, there's nothing to stop him. Schumer knows this, which is why he’s desperate to change the rules. But you and I can stop them. We can send a loud, clear message that America will not be taken over by the radical Left. We need strong leaders in the Senate who will stand up to this tyranny, and with your help, we can make sure that happens. We’re up against the Democratic machine, but with patriots like you by our side, we will prevail. Don’t let Schumer and Gillibrand silence conservative voices. name: Team Cornel West 2024
subject: We’ve Secured Georgia BallotAccess—But the Fight Isn’t Over!
body:
Dr. West is on the ballot in Georgia!

| | |
# Cornel West for President
---
---
[ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/dnc?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ga_victory2&n=1)
---
# **When we stand together,****we can overcome.**
---
Dear Peter, **We have some incredible news to share -** despite facing a significant court challenge, the Georgia Secretary of State has officially qualified Dr. Cornel West and Dr. Melina Abdullah for the presidential ballot in Georgia! This is a monumental victory for our campaign and for everyone who believes in truth, justice, and love. Dr. Cornel West captured the significance of this moment perfectly: "We are overjoyed by this decision, which not only upholds the democratic process but also reinforces the power of our collective voice. While challenges remain on the horizon, today’s victory reveals the strength of our grassroots commitment to truth, justice, and love." However, while we celebrate this important step forward, we know that the fight is far from over. The Democratic Party may still challenge this decision in court, and we need your help to ensure that we can continue to defend our place on the ballot—not just in Georgia, but across the country.
---
**Here's How You Can Help Keep Our Movement Strong:**
1. **Donate:** We are gearing up for critical legal battles in Pennsylvania and Virginia, and every contribution empowers us to combat these anti-democratic tactics and champion the cause of the unheard. Your support is vital as we prepare to ensure our place on the ballots and fight for a fair electoral process.
2. **Volunteer:** Join our campaign as a volunteer and help us spread our message of truth, justice, and love across the nation. Your involvement is vital as we expand our reach and impact.
3. **Spread the Word:** Talk about our victory and the ongoing struggle against a system designed to marginalize alternative voices. Share our vision with your community and on social media to help break the hold of the two-party duopoly.

---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/dnc?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ga_victory2&n=2 "Donate") [Donate](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/dnc?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ga_victory2&n=2)
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/join?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ga_victory2&n=3 "Join the Movement") [Join the Movement](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/join?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ga_victory2&n=3)
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/100_days?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ga_victory2&n=4 "Spread the Word") [Spread the Word](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/100_days?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ga_victory2&n=4)
---
Fatimah, our lead volunteer in Georgia, shared how much this victory means: "It sends a message to the great people of this country that we are Warriors for Justice fighting for all including those who are left out and forgotten. The audacity of a Super PAC's attempts to take away our freedom to choose Dr. West and Dr. Abdullah whom we think is best is appalling. We will continue our fight for fairness and equity. We are like David up against a Goliath continuously preparing for battle. We are not backing down!"
---
---
---
**Continuing the Fight for a True Democracy:** Our victories in Georgia, Wisconsin, Michigan, Maine, and North Carolina are just the beginning. As we press forward with vigor, we face significant upcoming legal battles in Pennsylvania and Virginia. These challenges are crucial as we refuse to endorse or enable the troubling politics of those who compromise on human rights and democracy. Our campaign provides an alternative for those seeking to vote their conscience and desire change. **This is the moment to rally together and ensure that our campaign continues to gain momentum. We’ve secured our place on the ballot in Georgia, but we need your support to keep moving forward.** [Your donation today will make a difference. Together, we can continue to fight for a democracy that works for everyone. Thank you for standing with us.](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/dnc?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ga_victory2&n=5)
---
## **Together, we are making history.**
The West/Abdullah campaign has the signatures and minor party nominations it needs to get on the ballot in 17 states. This includes 6 of the battleground states: Michigan, Georgia, Minnesota, Florida, Wisconsin and North Carolina. For more info, see our ballot access [map](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/ballotaccess?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ga_victory2&n=6). Thank you for standing with us. In solidarity, Edwin DeJesus
Director of Policy
West/Abdullah Campaign

Vance aren’t just the most anti-woman, anti-democratic GOP ticket in history — they’re plain weird. While most Americans are worried about putting dinner on the table, Donald and Vance are busy complaining that “childless cat ladies” are the real problem facing America. And they’re not just going after people who don’t have kids — they’re trying to control our personal decisions about pregnancy and parenthood entirely. In Donald and Vance’s America, families like mine would be under attack. I’m a “cat lady” who is lucky enough to have a human child thanks to fertility treatments. But because of my uncle’s work to pack our courts with extremist judges that led to the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ and abortion bans across the country, right-wing activists and lawmakers are now looking to restrict access to IVF and other fertility treatments next. **_These are scary times, but it’s good to know where everyone stands._** I stand with the women of America to protect our reproductive rights and bodily autonomy. So do Kamala Harris and Tim Walz. Walz has spoken openly about how he and his wife conceived their two children through fertility treatments. This fight is also personal to him. We know where Donald and Vance stand. And we need to make sure neither of them gets anywhere near the Oval Office. August 31, 2024
Below is an article written by my brother Nick, who is a registered Independent, lawyer and much better writer than I am. He makes a cogent case that Kamala Harris's career as a prosecutor resulted in the arrogance of one who is used to unbridled power and explains why she refuses to be questioned by the Press except in the most controlled circumstances. Nick makes the argument that such a person should not become President.
## Should A Prosecutor Be President?
by Nick Bentivegna
If you follow political trends in your hometown, you've probably heard the now fashionable campaign rhetoric from former prosecutors seeking public office. The tag line will read something like, "He (or she) is a tough prosecutor who put drug dealers, rapists and child molesters behind bars, and is now ready to fight for you, against corporate polluters, special interests, and those evil Republicans who can't wait to cancel your Social Security."
A prosecutor's stock in trade is asking questions. Lots of them. The right to do so is pretty much unfettered. A witness who answers back to a prosecutor with a question of his own will quickly be admonished, "I am asking the questions, not you!" Prosecutors are similarly tasked with presenting opening and closing statements, using whatever spin they like. Defense lawyers are forbidden to interrupt, though they do, of course, enjoy a right of rebuttal.
The prosecutor always plays offense. An egregious crime that can be easily proven is always good material for a show trial. On the other hand, even the most marginal of cases is usually good for a plea bargain, especially if a little fine money can be collected for the county. Most people accused of a crime do not want to take a chance on going to jail, even if they are innocent. Prosecutors, however, even when they lose, still get paid.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2b19caea-530e-4679-987a-2db5bf40d952?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Kamala Harris Questioning Judge Kavanaugh During Confirmation Hearings
Prosecutors function at all levels of government. Special Counsel Robert Mueller famously blew $45M of taxpayer money on the fantasy "Russian collusion" case, happily causing paralysis of Donald Trump's presidency. When it was all said and done, Mueller readily admitted not only that he didn't have a case, but that he didn't even have probable cause for bringing a case. Did he pay the money back? Are you kidding? Last we heard, the only "consequences" were retirement and a fat pension.
In the private sector, any lawyer who blows a massive amount of a client's money, with anywhere near the level of incompetence of a Robert Mueller, not to mention Jack Smith or Fani Willis, will need to arrange a date with his or her malpractice carrier. Ditto for an investment advisor who squanders a client's 401K, or a doctor who leaves a sponge inside a patient. But, for a prosecutor, accountability for failure is simply not part of the repertoire.
All of this being said, your local prosecutor turned politician may be an ideal fit for the halls of Congress! Former prosecutors can be particularly adept at undertaking endless investigations, grilling petrified witnesses, and making grand pronouncements before the TV cameras. It's what they do, and what they do best.
We now turn to our basic question, "Can a former prosecutor be President of the United States?" Well, we won't say "Never," but at this point, the bench is not looking too good. Read on.
A well-known axiom in the political world is that the skillset needed to campaign and win an election, is often quite different than that required to actually govern. Nowhere is this more evident than in the American presidency. "Hope and change" may triumph on election day, but, at some point, the public expects results. Fairly or unfairly, the President can expect to receive credit and admiration when times are good, and quite the opposite when things are bad. We've all seen those stickers of Joe Biden pointing to the price on the gas pump, and exclaiming, "I did that!"
Most of our more effective presidents have had broad executive experience at the top of large organizations or enterprises. Calvin Coolidge, Franklin Roosevelt, Ronald Reagan, and Bill Clinton, were all state governors. Dwight D. Eisenhower successfully commanded our armed forces, though the greatest war of all time. And yes, Donald J. Trump was, and is, particularly adept at running large and complex businesses. There have been presidents who have come up through the House and Senate, such as John F. Kennedy, Lyndon Johnson, and Barack Obama. Were you able to ask, however, I'm sure that each of them would admit that the learning curve, in moving from the legislative to the executive, was a bit steep.
One of the least qualified of our more recent presidents was Harry S. Truman. Truman made his name as a Senator, investigating fraud and corruption committed by military contractors, during the war effort. Not exactly a controversial task, but his competence and general affability garnered for him widespread respect, and he made very few enemies. Hastily selected as a compromise candidate, to run as Vice-President for Franklin Roosevelt's fourth term, Truman suddenly found himself in the "big chair," three months into his vice-presidency, when President Roosevelt unexpectedly passed away. Love him or hate him, Truman readily embraced the awesome responsibilities of the office, and famously kept a sign on his desk that read, "The Buck Stops Here."
Our current President, Joe Biden, was never a prosecutor. Prior to assuming the Presidency, he was never much of an executive, either. (During his eight years as Vice-President, Barack Obama kept him on a pretty short leash.) Elected as a Senator at the tender age of 29, Biden did manage to carve out a prosecutorial role for himself. Perhaps the high (or low) point of his 36 year Senatorial career was the sensational grilling of two Supreme Court nominees, Robert Bork and Clarence Thomas. Blustery, confident, and not particularly smart, Biden has always been given to making grandiose statements, with little basis in fact, much less any concern for accuracy or truth. As President, and now a demented old man, he really hasn't changed. To this day, there is perhaps no one in the country more skilled in the craft of looking straight into the camera, and telling a blatant lie.
Which brings us now to the current Democratic presidential candidate, Vice-President Kamala Harris. Harris likes to present herself as a tough "girl-boss" prosecutor. Indeed, during her time in the Senate, Harris followed in the footsteps of her mentor, Joe Biden, in her examination of Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh. Lauded by the mainstream press for her "brilliant takedown" of Kavanaugh, the C-Span version tells a somewhat different story. Kavanaugh comes off as a bit uncomfortable, yes, but mainly because he is trying to look judicial and respectful, in the face of what was essentially a vacuous and rather inane line of questioning.
As a vice-presidential candidate in 2020, Kamala Harris, of course, relied heavily on her prosecutorial habits and tactics. In her opening statement during the debate with Vice-President Mike Pence, she viciously laid out the argument that every Covid death in the country was directly attributable to President Donald Trump. It was a classic case of someone who has never been held accountable for anything, demanding that someone else be held accountable for everything.
My, how the tables have turned. VP Harris is in quite a different spot this time around. As a core component of the eponymous Biden-Harris administration, she has a record. Inflation, illegal immigration, and the disastrous withdrawal from Afghanistan, are all on the public's mind. And, there is little question as to who is to blame for the state the country finds itself in.
Kamala Harris's entire political career, however, was built upon asking a lot of questions, and occasionally giving carefully prepared and scripted public statements. The teleprompter is her best friend. As one who is acutely aware of the power of a penetrating cross-examination, she is loathe to submit herself to anything of the sort. Hence the lack of press conferences, interviews, or spontaneous responses to random questions shouted out by reporters. Indeed, her only interview thus far has been a taped and edited performance, aided and abetted by a friendly journalist, in which the "girl-boss" brought along a male friend, Tim Walz, for protection and emotional support. Vladimir Putin, no doubt, is trembling with fear at the very prospect of matching wits with this dynamic duo.
Can a prosecutor become President? Well, hopefully not this time.
Kamala Harris insists that we need to visualize "What can be, unburdened by what has been." On that point, given "what has been," as a consequence of the Biden-Harris administration, we couldn't agree more.

Most people accused of a crime do not want to take a chance on going to jail, even if they are innocent. Prosecutors, however, even when they lose, still get paid. | | ---|---|--- Kamala Harris Questioning Judge Kavanaugh During Confirmation Hearings Prosecutors function at all levels of government. Special Counsel Robert Mueller famously blew $45M of taxpayer money on the fantasy "Russian collusion" case, happily causing paralysis of Donald Trump's presidency. When it was all said and done, Mueller readily admitted not only that he didn't have a case, but that he didn't even have probable cause for bringing a case. Did he pay the money back? Are you kidding? Last we heard, the only "consequences" were retirement and a fat pension. In the private sector, any lawyer who blows a massive amount of a client's money, with anywhere near the level of incompetence of a Robert Mueller, not to mention Jack Smith or Fani Willis, will need to arrange a date with his or her malpractice carrier. Ditto for an investment advisor who squanders a client's 401K, or a doctor who leaves a sponge inside a patient. But, for a prosecutor, accountability for failure is simply not part of the repertoire. All of this being said, your local prosecutor turned politician may be an ideal fit for the halls of Congress! Former prosecutors can be particularly adept at undertaking endless investigations, grilling petrified witnesses, and making grand pronouncements before the TV cameras. It's what they do, and what they do best. We now turn to our basic question, "Can a former prosecutor be President of the United States?" Well, we won't say "Never," but at this point, the bench is not looking too good. Read on. A well-known axiom in the political world is that the skillset needed to campaign and win an election, is often quite different than that required to actually govern. Nowhere is this more evident than in the American presidency. "Hope and change" may triumph on election day, but, at some point, the public expects results. Fairly or unfairly, the President can expect to receive credit and admiration when times are good, and quite the opposite when things are bad. We've all seen those stickers of Joe Biden pointing to the price on the gas pump, and exclaiming, "I did that!" Most of our more effective presidents have had broad executive experience at the top of large organizations or enterprises. Calvin Coolidge, Franklin Roosevelt, Ronald Reagan, and Bill Clinton, were all state governors. Dwight D. Eisenhower successfully commanded our armed forces, though the greatest war of all time. And yes, Donald J. Trump was, and is, particularly adept at running large and complex businesses. There have been presidents who have come up through the House and Senate, such as John F. Kennedy, Lyndon Johnson, and Barack Obama. Were you able to ask, however, I'm sure that each of them would admit that the learning curve, in moving from the legislative to the executive, was a bit steep. One of the least qualified of our more recent presidents was Harry S. Truman. Truman made his name as a Senator, investigating fraud and corruption committed by military contractors, during the war effort. Not exactly a controversial task, but his competence and general affability garnered for him widespread respect, and he made very few enemies. Hastily selected as a compromise candidate, to run as Vice-President for Franklin Roosevelt's fourth term, Truman suddenly found himself in the "big chair," three months into his vice-presidency, when President Roosevelt unexpectedly passed away. Love him or hate him, Truman readily embraced the awesome responsibilities of the office, and famously kept a sign on his desk that read, "The Buck Stops Here." Our current President, Joe Biden, was never a prosecutor. Prior to assuming the Presidency, he was never much of an executive, either. (During his eight years as Vice-President, Barack Obama kept him on a pretty short leash.) Elected as a Senator at the tender age of 29, Biden did manage to carve out a prosecutorial role for himself. Perhaps the high (or low) point of his 36 year Senatorial career was the sensational grilling of two Supreme Court nominees, Robert Bork and Clarence Thomas. Blustery, confident, and not particularly smart, Biden has always been given to making grandiose statements, with little basis in fact, much less any concern for accuracy or truth. As President, and now a demented old man, he really hasn't changed. To this day, there is perhaps no one in the country more skilled in the craft of looking straight into the camera, and telling a blatant lie. Which brings us now to the current Democratic presidential candidate, Vice-President Kamala Harris. Harris likes to present herself as a tough "girl-boss" prosecutor. Indeed, during her time in the Senate, Harris followed in the footsteps of her mentor, Joe Biden, in her examination of Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh. Lauded by the mainstream press for her "brilliant takedown" of Kavanaugh, the C-Span version tells a somewhat different story. Kavanaugh comes off as a bit uncomfortable, yes, but mainly because he is trying to look judicial and respectful, in the face of what was essentially a vacuous and rather inane line of questioning. As a vice-presidential candidate in 2020, Kamala Harris, of course, relied heavily on her prosecutorial habits and tactics. In her opening statement during the debate with Vice-President Mike Pence, she viciously laid out the argument that every Covid death in the country was directly attributable to President Donald Trump. It was a classic case of someone who has never been held accountable for anything, demanding that someone else be held accountable for everything. My, how the tables have turned. VP Harris is in quite a different spot this time around. As a core component of the eponymous Biden-Harris administration, she has a record. Inflation, illegal immigration, and the disastrous withdrawal from Afghanistan, are all on the public's mind. And, there is little question as to who is to blame for the state the country finds itself in. Kamala Harris's entire political career, however, was built upon asking a lot of questions, and occasionally giving carefully prepared and scripted public statements. The teleprompter is her best friend. As one who is acutely aware of the power of a penetrating cross-examination, she is loathe to submit herself to anything of the sort. Hence the lack of press conferences, interviews, or spontaneous responses to random questions shouted out by reporters. Indeed, her only interview thus far has been a taped and edited performance, aided and abetted by a friendly journalist, in which the "girl-boss" brought along a male friend, Tim Walz, for protection and emotional support. Vladimir Putin, no doubt, is trembling with fear at the very prospect of matching wits with this dynamic duo. Can a prosecutor become President? Well, hopefully not this time. Kamala Harris insists that we need to visualize "What can be, unburdened by what has been." On that point, given "what has been," as a consequence of the Biden-Harris administration, we couldn't agree more.
