August 31, 2024
Below is an article written by my brother Nick, who is a registered Independent, lawyer and much better writer than I am. He makes a cogent case that Kamala Harris's career as a prosecutor resulted in the arrogance of one who is used to unbridled power and explains why she refuses to be questioned by the Press except in the most controlled circumstances. Nick makes the argument that such a person should not become President.
## Should A Prosecutor Be President?
by Nick Bentivegna
If you follow political trends in your hometown, you've probably heard the now fashionable campaign rhetoric from former prosecutors seeking public office. The tag line will read something like, "He (or she) is a tough prosecutor who put drug dealers, rapists and child molesters behind bars, and is now ready to fight for you, against corporate polluters, special interests, and those evil Republicans who can't wait to cancel your Social Security."
A prosecutor's stock in trade is asking questions. Lots of them. The right to do so is pretty much unfettered. A witness who answers back to a prosecutor with a question of his own will quickly be admonished, "I am asking the questions, not you!" Prosecutors are similarly tasked with presenting opening and closing statements, using whatever spin they like. Defense lawyers are forbidden to interrupt, though they do, of course, enjoy a right of rebuttal.
The prosecutor always plays offense. An egregious crime that can be easily proven is always good material for a show trial. On the other hand, even the most marginal of cases is usually good for a plea bargain, especially if a little fine money can be collected for the county. Most people accused of a crime do not want to take a chance on going to jail, even if they are innocent. Prosecutors, however, even when they lose, still get paid.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c7a150de-449b-446c-88ca-68317adfe0ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Kamala Harris Questioning Judge Kavanaugh During Confirmation Hearings
Prosecutors function at all levels of government. Special Counsel Robert Mueller famously blew $45M of taxpayer money on the fantasy "Russian collusion" case, happily causing paralysis of Donald Trump's presidency. When it was all said and done, Mueller readily admitted not only that he didn't have a case, but that he didn't even have probable cause for bringing a case. Did he pay the money back? Are you kidding? Last we heard, the only "consequences" were retirement and a fat pension.
In the private sector, any lawyer who blows a massive amount of a client's money, with anywhere near the level of incompetence of a Robert Mueller, not to mention Jack Smith or Fani Willis, will need to arrange a date with his or her malpractice carrier. Ditto for an investment advisor who squanders a client's 401K, or a doctor who leaves a sponge inside a patient. But, for a prosecutor, accountability for failure is simply not part of the repertoire.
All of this being said, your local prosecutor turned politician may be an ideal fit for the halls of Congress! Former prosecutors can be particularly adept at undertaking endless investigations, grilling petrified witnesses, and making grand pronouncements before the TV cameras. It's what they do, and what they do best.
We now turn to our basic question, "Can a former prosecutor be President of the United States?" Well, we won't say "Never," but at this point, the bench is not looking too good. Read on.
A well-known axiom in the political world is that the skillset needed to campaign and win an election, is often quite different than that required to actually govern. Nowhere is this more evident than in the American presidency. "Hope and change" may triumph on election day, but, at some point, the public expects results. Fairly or unfairly, the President can expect to receive credit and admiration when times are good, and quite the opposite when things are bad. We've all seen those stickers of Joe Biden pointing to the price on the gas pump, and exclaiming, "I did that!"
Most of our more effective presidents have had broad executive experience at the top of large organizations or enterprises. Calvin Coolidge, Franklin Roosevelt, Ronald Reagan, and Bill Clinton, were all state governors. Dwight D. Eisenhower successfully commanded our armed forces, though the greatest war of all time. And yes, Donald J. Trump was, and is, particularly adept at running large and complex businesses. There have been presidents who have come up through the House and Senate, such as John F. Kennedy, Lyndon Johnson, and Barack Obama. Were you able to ask, however, I'm sure that each of them would admit that the learning curve, in moving from the legislative to the executive, was a bit steep.
One of the least qualified of our more recent presidents was Harry S. Truman. Truman made his name as a Senator, investigating fraud and corruption committed by military contractors, during the war effort. Not exactly a controversial task, but his competence and general affability garnered for him widespread respect, and he made very few enemies. Hastily selected as a compromise candidate, to run as Vice-President for Franklin Roosevelt's fourth term, Truman suddenly found himself in the "big chair," three months into his vice-presidency, when President Roosevelt unexpectedly passed away. Love him or hate him, Truman readily embraced the awesome responsibilities of the office, and famously kept a sign on his desk that read, "The Buck Stops Here."
Our current President, Joe Biden, was never a prosecutor. Prior to assuming the Presidency, he was never much of an executive, either. (During his eight years as Vice-President, Barack Obama kept him on a pretty short leash.) Elected as a Senator at the tender age of 29, Biden did manage to carve out a prosecutorial role for himself. Perhaps the high (or low) point of his 36 year Senatorial career was the sensational grilling of two Supreme Court nominees, Robert Bork and Clarence Thomas. Blustery, confident, and not particularly smart, Biden has always been given to making grandiose statements, with little basis in fact, much less any concern for accuracy or truth. As President, and now a demented old man, he really hasn't changed. To this day, there is perhaps no one in the country more skilled in the craft of looking straight into the camera, and telling a blatant lie.
Which brings us now to the current Democratic presidential candidate, Vice-President Kamala Harris. Harris likes to present herself as a tough "girl-boss" prosecutor. Indeed, during her time in the Senate, Harris followed in the footsteps of her mentor, Joe Biden, in her examination of Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh. Lauded by the mainstream press for her "brilliant takedown" of Kavanaugh, the C-Span version tells a somewhat different story. Kavanaugh comes off as a bit uncomfortable, yes, but mainly because he is trying to look judicial and respectful, in the face of what was essentially a vacuous and rather inane line of questioning.
As a vice-presidential candidate in 2020, Kamala Harris, of course, relied heavily on her prosecutorial habits and tactics. In her opening statement during the debate with Vice-President Mike Pence, she viciously laid out the argument that every Covid death in the country was directly attributable to President Donald Trump. It was a classic case of someone who has never been held accountable for anything, demanding that someone else be held accountable for everything.
My, how the tables have turned. VP Harris is in quite a different spot this time around. As a core component of the eponymous Biden-Harris administration, she has a record. Inflation, illegal immigration, and the disastrous withdrawal from Afghanistan, are all on the public's mind. And, there is little question as to who is to blame for the state the country finds itself in.
Kamala Harris's entire political career, however, was built upon asking a lot of questions, and occasionally giving carefully prepared and scripted public statements. The teleprompter is her best friend. As one who is acutely aware of the power of a penetrating cross-examination, she is loathe to submit herself to anything of the sort. Hence the lack of press conferences, interviews, or spontaneous responses to random questions shouted out by reporters. Indeed, her only interview thus far has been a taped and edited performance, aided and abetted by a friendly journalist, in which the "girl-boss" brought along a male friend, Tim Walz, for protection and emotional support. Vladimir Putin, no doubt, is trembling with fear at the very prospect of matching wits with this dynamic duo.
Can a prosecutor become President? Well, hopefully not this time.
Kamala Harris insists that we need to visualize "What can be, unburdened by what has been." On that point, given "what has been," as a consequence of the Biden-Harris administration, we couldn't agree more.

subject: I was exposed to toxic burn pits in Iraq

body:
...and Republicans like Josh Hawley abandoned veterans like me
#
Peter — I’m Lt. Col. Lucas Kunce, USMCR, 13 years of active duty.
**After three tours of duty in Iraq and Afghanistan, I never imagined I would return home and face more attacks.** But that’s what happened two years ago, when Josh Hawley and 40 other Republicans blocked a bill to expand healthcare to millions of veterans like me who were exposed to toxic burn pits during their service.
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/69844?refcode=em20240831-7512&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7512%2E614464%2EL1_V-p)**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/69844?refcode=em20240831-7512&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7512%2E614464%2EL1_V-p)
**Let me tell you what happened, so you know why I’m running for U.S. Senate.**
In Iraq, I deployed to the Sunni Triangle where I led a police training team. Twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman, running missions through Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Ramadi. **From our camp, the base’s burn pit loomed over us.**
Smoke columns filled the sky and blew through our living space. We ran through it, joking about how we should be doing gas mask runs. For three months that pit bathed us in toxic fumes. We accepted it and focused on our duty.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/69844?refcode=em20240831-7512&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7512%2E614464%2EL1_V-p)
When I got home from that deployment, I had developed a persistent tickle in my throat. Constant irritation. I never had allergies before and annoyed myself with the constant throat clearing. Eventually, I was so embarrassed by it that I went to the base clinic. They said it was postnasal drip and that they could give me allergy medicine. There was no formal diagnosis. But over 10 years later, it’s still there.
Bothersome. Uncomfortable, but certainly manageable. **And that’s about the best story you’ll hear about a vet who’s been exposed to burn pits.** Many struggle with chronic respiratory issues. Migraines. Cancer.
So imagine how we all felt when politicians who have never worn the uniform, like Josh Hawley, threw us a giant middle finger and voted against aid for veterans who were exposed to these toxic burn pits.
I know that’s harsh language, but it has to be. Because what they did was about as anti-American as it gets. Patriots don’t attack veterans who suffered injuries or illness from being around those toxic pits.
Many of these same Republicans spent years voting to keep us in these forever wars, lying to the American people about what was really going on over there, and getting rich off their defense contractor stocks that skyrocket when we’re at war.
These people profited off of sending us over there only to screw us when we came back messed up. **It’s criminal — and I’m ready to do something about it.**
I served my country for 13 years in the United States Marine Corps. I’d give anything for this country — and that’s exactly why I’m running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate.
**[If you’re with me, will you please consider donating $10 or anything at all so we can get this message in front of voters and defeat Josh Hawley this November? I’m not taking a single cent from corporate PACs in this race, so any amount you can give will have a massive impact on our grassroots campaign.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/69844?refcode=em20240831-7512&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7512%2E614464%2EL1_V-p)**

body:
When Mark Kelly thinks about the people who have been his top supporters over the last few years, it’s not just the people who write the biggest checks who come to mind.
#

Friends —
When Mark Kelly thinks about the people who have been his top supporters over the last few years, it’s not just the people who write the biggest checks who come to mind.
It’s the people who were there when everything was on the line.
Like you.
---

Your support has been critical in turning the tide in our fight against MAGA extremism.
You helped us flip this seat in Arizona in 2020 and re-elect Mark in 2022. And now, Mark is helping lead the fight to protect the White House, hold the Senate, and fip the House of Representatives.
---

But here’s something we thought you should know: Out of all the people who read these emails, less than 25% of them have made a donation to support his work.
Today, we’re asking you to join them.

Hi Peter,

This week, we had a special meeting with almost all of our Pennsylvania candidates about how Her Bold Move could help ensure Republicans don’t win the majority in November.

**The takeaway:** We have plans for a big push in PA in these final months before Election Day.

**The reason:** Pennsylvania Republicans have been unequivocal about saying that they want to bring an anti-abortion referendum if they get the majority, which the Democratic Governor would be unable to block. Therefore, reproductive rights in PA hinge on whether Dems keep the majority this fall -- and the margins between Democratic control and Republican control are too thin for comfort in the state's legislature (4 seats TOTAL could make or break the future for this critically important state).

**The plan:** We have already begun endorsing fiercely pro-choice and progressive women running for office in competitive districts around the state. Pennsylvania Democrats hold a one-seat majority in the House, and we are within striking distance of gaining a majority in the Senate.

Through our Candidate Connections program, we have also held brainstorming sessions with all of our PA candidates to give them the space to share tips and tricks as they enter these critical weeks ahead of November and to hear how we can best support their campaigns.

Friend, This past week, the University of Michigan sent in police to violently arrest anti-genocide protesters, in a shameful sign of the repressive tactics to come at schools across the country this semester. College and university administrators, and the boards that oversee them, are still trying to silence students for exercising their First Amendment rights to free speech and assembly. These students should be listened to and praised for standing up for peace—not vilified, silenced, or made homeless after being banned from campus. During the wave of Gaza solidarity encampments earlier this year, I had the chance to spend time with students in my state of Michigan demanding divestment from weapons manufacturers, including at my alma mater Wayne State University. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rl0EAMX48IJgQ7iCSWsbbcudTzsjCJEadn461GaJZ-4WszxwX2xShkrxHO7jctc0T3vT5eShmvXZJR8E9_CLgxHtoF4FksuNjOSbHladUMzcTKALvVrEVVQUs4m4jrf87E9Omny5y0RSnP0S354IfxgEm6bhx2HepuThE_UCcWvIBGCJkLgyIm-unL0hFFWvcxKqWBafBrxajkVlIG0-xcd__3fnQ75BylIErEPcO7Q9ZyYmBrPAqoVmeWryy-mOK8TqhfctVj72fgVAyAre3S--eB7dAilNBl7c5vIKFOsmGNktnQjerW4EuRPlZDLiPQXzFkn9Rp3aIBS8RbAQ8Q4DHhSW3am8yP6wYeLjTY8cI3_VXzstCx1Gl7K-dA3OjD1fNwGnKwbCOWRIjo9bm_0x2LfwTxlocPRVxrnYGqLHTvAD4Nr3KotoGtstngonNRraYlRJS8KmgcRHUE4ac_28TWQG_9opuxisJW9cOFA/49d/Cl7a_3W3SOeqfZlGbjYA6w/h1/h001.d_KDF8OKLT5X0-WS4W8fNoczuxyGnUjL4_LNHxqdObo) While I was on Wayne State’s campus, officers in a police SUV tried to drive through a crowd of students. **For calling to save lives, college students and staff have been brutally beaten, tased, and sprayed with toxic chemicals.** Instead of suppressing protests, we must abide by U.S. and international law and heed the public’s call to end U.S. weapons shipments to Israel as it commits genocide against Palestinians. [**Sign to demand school administrators and boards listen to students demanding divestment from genocide, rather than criminalizing them. Academic institutions are places for learning and discussion, not violent crackdowns on our First Amendment right to free speech.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rl0EAMX48IJgQ7iCSWsbbcudTzsjCJEadn461GaJZ-4WszxwX2xShkrxHO7jctc0T3vT5eShmvXZJR8E9_CLgxHtoF4FksuNjOSbHladUMzcTKALvVrEVVQUs4m4jrf87E9Omny5y0RSnP0S354IfxgEm6bhx2HepuThE_UCcWu0UJsSpL93IIGxzxrtCd5hKusaU_U4mdrBzg8nqs5pURXG6Ze5mV6mBy5aiiMmckBrFlYDb2bWD55CO26zdWNUpBBC1waIhy56B3H1QdqPrXJ-F3QphZuxGU41YOt2dmjDuwVVdkaUHW7WEYeirXVoTc_SVI6eSAjtta6ym9NUskykmaWCqclh6D7m2-fkxNVZd-FEOrZ2S1HENS7p_ox_sWFYkgQzViqRO8QdTL56cR1C9Vw59OVdr17gXOK_6iJOBzGEF8kGhsUI34Bt_928dr1ehxvYg5V7GeaAwNBRyONGvhpbdEK-C8pSgFudarg/49d/Cl7a_3W3SOeqfZlGbjYA6w/h2/h001.a8y9ZjlfipI0wBn0WS2qgNGbgbHHdeeAXbFBGV2Rp6k) | [SIGN NOW](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rl0EAMX48IJgQ7iCSWsbbcudTzsjCJEadn461GaJZ-4WszxwX2xShkrxHO7jctc0T3vT5eShmvXZJR8E9_CLgxHtoF4FksuNjOSbHladUMzcTKALvVrEVVQUs4m4jrf87E9Omny5y0RSnP0S354IfxgEm6bhx2HepuThE_UCcWlWQCCdVKcE7HwETDO0YZ8TykwuYD-105tlGVbanmwVPKyFmoF6Lq-BknMdB3iflNwroq4JyBEAbTA2C2KyvV5-T8rvmBH0ZrnyqCCA4LhmLKjH8GZePKw1uDay6jcKHQjzfvjEHfXe2fOyaXEvyGA2keQ4fg6mkdAqsaGHwfmsoLiBhiGArMozLNCpAVh6JcXbK7QmwTOMkzbYZ5g9peRc1z9hMuZN-QWGOUOnbvg7M7F122T3ENvjZ3VJuZge5zfWrHBBY-B8I0A1gsU6f3K02ZGD-mDedCiNbgapCQ7ythf1xQO7CBZFbTdiAeoRa3Q/49d/Cl7a_3W3SOeqfZlGbjYA6w/h3/h001.n_K9N1FoJvIJNbpGLrglCVdW9ys_IgmFY_9MR6SFPC0)

It’s disgraceful that university administrators and government officials in our country have been sending in militarized police forces and even snipers to stop students from exercising their First Amendment rights.**** Earlier this year, more than 3,000 students, faculty, and staff were brutally arrested and many were hospitalized from violent arrests.
The movement is still going strong, and has already won some victories with a number of universities taking steps to divest from weapons manufacturers.
Instead of harming their students and staff who are speaking up for peace, universities must instead listen to and protect the people on their campuses who are demanding a better world. U.S. lawmakers must also listen to their constituents, the vast majority of whom are demanding an end to arming Israel’s military as it violates Palestinians’ human rights.
I promise to continue defending our rights and saving lives at home and abroad.
In solidarity,
Rashida

While I was on Wayne State’s campus, officers in a police SUV tried to drive through a crowd of students. For calling to save lives, college students and staff have been brutally beaten, tased, and sprayed with toxic chemicals. The movement is still going strong, and has already won some victories with a number of universities taking steps to divest from weapons manufacturers. Instead of harming their students and staff who are speaking up for peace, universities must instead listen to and protect the people on their campuses who are demanding a better world. Our country must stop arming war crimes and violations of international law. We must listen to—not silence or brutalize—the U.S. students and school employees who are demanding an end to this ethnic cleansing. Many of these protests have already led to universities divesting. The right to protest is essential to social change and to democracy. It’s also a fundamental constitutional right as part of our free speech protections in the First Amendment. Hi Peter,

I know it’s Labor Day weekend, so I’ll make this quick.

It may be a holiday, but my team and I still have a crucial month-end fundraising deadline at midnight tonight.

We’re closing in on Martin Heinrich and on the cusp of turning this into a full-on toss-up race for Senate here in New Mexico.

_But missing this deadline would compromise all the momentum we’ve built._

[**Can you chip in just $7 or more before midnight to ensure we hit our August goal and stay on course to pull off a victory in this race?**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=0cfc51eced374a7088f063bde7418951&_e=T2WAQFu9BIhr3b2aD3rxDrDn8l0FurVYhuWEPjxMQsySwVZP3sWF9yhySj55jgQ5gamFyINiDaYlpekZq_5n82_WaLH_Usyn3R2pXG1gmjzmdiYbyO8Ft6DDZ-7q_bOtwgzZLApeceX_pMeNtbunaf58iwU2IpOUZF14Q1oVV5VoLuOW_S2e4-VGHfmPf2mR92WOZJnmTOWpjuD6VASwuUIzcRE30Y82sYDg0f0peOz-p1q5UEONT5YRUE-oin8uqSh6_uoGCNOKa-eBpXi8nApEXDF8NpZmmU3jlSGaizHAhQyptiaF48vrUvKCjKKD6Ca0ysoKVjZzujP74VN1TT6zMBK8rf8n9EkKKv4eeuILwEAwN16OnIniJP_DxE5Ecws2L6PdSuWTm0PIGdAICw%3D%3D)

Thank you so much for any support you can give today!

_**-Nella Domenici**_

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Between serving in Congress, coaching our kids' flag football teams, campaigning non-stop, and recently winning the 2024 Republican Primary, Juan has sacrificed so much for our family. Join us today as we celebrate him! Our family is counting the days until Election Day -- 66 days to be exact -- and we are more focused than ever to win our race decisively. For this reason, the best gift you can give my hubby is a BIG fundraising day. Will you help me surprise Juan with a big fundraising day? Chip in $42, $242 or even a little more? | "$42" | "$242" | "Or More!" | Again, thank you for all the support throughout the campaign. body:
Every year, my wife and I go to Arlington National Cemetery to pay our respects to the fallen. Some killed in action, some died of wounds, injuries, or illnesses related to service, some of natural causes at home. All served with honor.
#
Paul Eaton here, wanted to send a personal note about something that has left me shocked, disturbed, and absolutely disgusted.
Every year, my wife and I go to Arlington National Cemetery to pay our respects to the fallen. Some killed in action, some died of wounds, injuries, or illnesses related to service, some of natural causes at home. All served with honor.
Among them are my father and his co-pilot, shot down over Laos during the Vietnam War. They were missing in action for thirty years, but now they are at peace together in that solemn and dignified place where the very best of our nation rest.
I’ve stood with my dear friend, Karen Meredith, at the grave of her son, 1LT Ken Ballard, in Section 60 where the fallen from the Global War on Terror are buried.
These are powerful experiences for me, and they should be for everyone who goes to this hallowed ground.
To hear that Donald Trump descreated this place, that he took photographs and video among the graves of the fallen without their families' permission... That he mugged for the camera for political gain is absolutely disgusting to me. That an Arlington official attempting to enforce the law and defend the dignity of Arlington was assaulted, verbally and physically, by Trump’s staff so they could access Section 60... I cannot even begin to comprehend it.
I want to be absolutely clear: This is something I have never seen or heard of in my entire life. To my knowledge, something like this has never occurred. And someone who can do something like that has no place leading the men and women of our Armed Forces.
Donald Trump cannot become Commander in Chief again.
It is on us to make sure that does not happen. That is why I am proud to work with VoteVets, and it is why I am asking you to make a donation to support our work right now.
[**Please, if you can make a donation of anything at all, we will use it to ensure that the American people never forget that Donald Trump desecrated one of our most sacred places. But during an election year, the first Ohio State kickoff means Election Day is inching closer – and that means we need you now more than ever. You see, our August fundraising deadline is at midnight, and my finance director just texted to let me know we’re not on track to reach our goal. I'm sure I don't need to tell you how bad it would be to fall short at this stage in the race. With 66 days until Election Day (yes, I've started a countdown), polls are deadlocked, and Republicans are spending record amounts to flip my seat and the Senate red. So I'm reaching out to you directly, friend, so we can reach our goal and power through the rest of this race:= Thank you so much, friend – and go Buckeyes! = | | = | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. **With the GOP prepared to invest millions of dollars into flipping New York red, I’ve set an ambitious $200,000 end-of-month fundraising goal.**
I rely on donations from grassroots supporters like you to hit these goals — not corporate PACs. That’s why I’m about to ask you to make a donation to help me meet this critical end-of-month goal. **[_(If you’re ready to give now, you can chip in here.)_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91915430/495382931/-862660935?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5339-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMDI1OTc1NS1hZjY3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vrj72TGAEmL5_PvhIqUM5Bxxk_HBj_W3kOc9vWwNefE=)**

Thank you for having my back as I lead the fight to protect **Social Security and Medicare** and ensure that seniors can retire in dignity.

Thank you for proudly standing with me in my fight to **certify the Equal Rights Amendment.** Today, we’re so close to finally establishing gender equality in our Constitution — giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights.
**But here's the bad news: If Republicans flip even one Senate seat, they could retake the majority and _undo all of our progress_. body:
#
My sister-in-service Ayanna Pressley is up for reelection in the Massachusetts primary next Tuesday, September 3 — the last primary for the Squad this year.
Between demanding answers and accountability from the leaders of Project 2025, traveling to get-out-the-vote for Jamaal Bowman and Cori Bush, and hitting the trail for Vice President Kamala Harris, Ayanna has been a relentless force for our movement this year.

Hello,
After the 2022 election, I had a hard decision to make.
When I ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, I knew we could win. No one believed me – not the Democratic party, not the Republican party, and certainly none of the political pundits.
Ultimately, though, after the recount, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country.
We were outspent heavily by Boebert and her allies. And the attacks and the vicious lies they told about me were really hard on my family – especially my two teenage children.
After we came so close to winning against Boebert, everyone expected me to run again in 2024. It seemed like a no-brainer. But it wasn’t an easy decision to put my family through what I knew was going to be an even nastier race than the last.

I’ve fought long and hard during my first term in the House — to protect our planet, for working families, and accountability for fraudulent lawmakers like Marjorie Taylor Greene, who constantly spew hatred and lies. And I am grateful to have had this team stand by my side every step of the way.
**But here’s the truth: My team reached out to me earlier this week letting me know that we are pacing behind our August fundraising goals. I am concerned. Concerned that our movement is losing momentum. And concerned that we won’t be able to accomplish our goal of taking back the House majority.**
If you don’t already know, as Freshman Class President of the Democrats, I have been working hard to support every vulnerable Freshman House Democrat in their re-election efforts — because I believe that our best chance at taking back the House majority from extremist Republicans begins with holding on to every competitive seat in the House.
But the reality is that campaigns are expensive and so is supporting 33 other Freshman Democrats. But we cannot let money stop us from fighting against the dangers of MAGA extremism for working families, immigrants, the LGBTQ+ community, and everyone in America.

Please see a special message from our

Dear Friend,

Your participation in Hillsdale
College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is
requested.

Your response will only take a few
minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and
the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the
proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court
differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the
bench.

Do you agree that the role of the
Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and
NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?

YES

NO

Even worse, progressives dismayed by
recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with
additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put
it in a Boston Globe op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to
a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by
four or more seats."

That is why I'm reaching out to you
today...

What is your opinion about the Supreme
Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me
using the College's National Survey on the United States Supreme
Court right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form
effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the proper
role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution
instead of legislating from the bench.

From: **Brianna** <allontheline@redistrictingaction.org>
Date: Fri, Aug 30, 2024 at 1:30 PM EST
Subject: Fair maps 🤝 fair elections
> First, the good news on voter participation, Peter:
> * **In Wisconsin’s primary earlier this month** — the first election after new fair maps were enacted — the highest number of voters in 60 years turned out for a presidential year partisan primary. One draw? New competitive districts. This follows what we’ve seen again and again: Fair maps motivate more people to get involved in elections!
>

> Now, the bad news:
> * In**Arizona,** a ballot initiative would essentially stop term limits for state supreme and appellate court judges — and the ballot initiative would be retroactive. If it passes, it would overturn the results of any election this November that unseats a current state supreme court justice. This includes two GOP judges who ruled to uphold the state’s Civil War-era abortion ban, who voters are trying to get out of office. **This would take power away from voters after they cast their ballots — and it’s a tremendous, partisan abuse of power.**
> * In**Louisiana** , newly fair maps are in place (and will stay in place!) for November — but afterwards, Black voters could lose an opportunity district if the current district lines are overturned. Black Louisianians make up about one-third of the state’s population, but would only have the opportunity to elect the candidate of their choice in just one of the state’s six congressional districts if the current congressional map is overturned.**This is another attempt to water down the power of voters.**
> * In **Georgia,** the election certification processes keep changing, and the election board plans to meet next month to consider even more rule changes. This is confusing for poll workers and election officials, and these last-minute changes could lead to issues on November 5 when it’s time to count votes. **These are partisan games that could have monumental consequences for the state’s election.**
>
[**These states are clear examples of why we need fair maps and fair elections. And at All On The Line, we’re committed to both.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91921472/495403714/1243206785?refcode=don_aotl_redite_email_AugEOM_email_20240830-AOTL-RedLite-AugEOM3_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240830-AOTL-RedLite-AugEOM3_&utm_campaign=AugEOM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk2OWQxNDgyLWJhNjctZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=WEnawizVzdXyd3uyrpiZcKkPEMbdFrFgbVHDhEb40vE=)

So we’re asking if 8 more people in CA can chip in. = = Every donation helps build a future without gerrymandering, with fair districts, and with accountable, responsive elected leaders. Thank you for being on this team and helping to achieve that mission. — All On The Line Finance Team \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Brianna <allontheline@redistrictingaction.org> Date: Fri, Aug 30, 2024 at 1:30 PM EST Subject: Fair maps 🤝 fair elections First, the good news on voter participation, Peter: In Wisconsin’s primary earlier this month — the first election after new fair maps were enacted — the highest number of voters in 60 years turned out for a presidential year partisan primary. One draw? New competitive districts. This follows what we’ve seen again and again: Fair maps motivate more people to get involved in elections! Now, the bad news: InArizona, a ballot initiative would essentially stop term limits for state supreme and appellate court judges — and the ballot initiative would be retroactive. If it passes, it would overturn the results of any election this November that unseats a current state supreme court justice. This includes two GOP judges who ruled to uphold the state’s Civil War-era abortion ban, who voters are trying to get out of office. This would take power away from voters after they cast their ballots — and it’s a tremendous, partisan abuse of power. InLouisiana , newly fair maps are in place (and will stay in place!) for November — but afterwards, Black voters could lose an opportunity district if the current district lines are overturned. Black Louisianians make up about one-third of the state’s population, but would only have the opportunity to elect the candidate of their choice in just one of the state’s six congressional districts if the current congressional map is overturned.This is another attempt to water down the power of voters. In Georgia, the election certification processes keep changing, and the election board plans to meet next month to consider even more rule changes. This is confusing for poll workers and election officials, and these last-minute changes could lead to issues on November 5 when it’s time to count votes. These are partisan games that could have monumental consequences for the state’s election. = Bad actors keep trying to tilt the scales in their favor by silencing voters’ voices — from restricting voting rights to manipulating maps. body:

Friends,
Imagine waking up the day after the election, knowing that YOU helped remove the most dangerous man in Congress from power.
In her fiery speech at the Democratic National Convention last week, Michelle Obama made a simple call to action: Do something.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240831_michell_obame_dnc_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240831_michell_obame_dnc_image]
Listen , there has never been a better opportunity for us to oust Jim Jordan, and I’ll tell you why.
*
Jim

This is the year we send Jim Jordan packing, and this is the campaign to do it!
But what we can’t do is wake up the day after the election wondering if we did enough.
So, in the spirit of Michelle Obama – I’m asking you to DO SOMETHING.
We know that this country, and especially its most vulnerable, can’t afford another two years of Jim Jordan and another four years of Donald Trump as they gear up for an authoritarian takeover of our rights. To stop them, we need to elect Kamala Harris and take back the House, which runs right through our district. Contribute today to help us win this fight. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240831_michell_obame_dnc_link1]
The former First Lady also urged us, “Don’t let anyone tell you who you are. You show them who you are.”
Jim Jordan has shown us exactly who he is over and over again.
He’s the man who enabled abuse at The Ohio State University, turning a blind eye to the sexual abuse of young athletes.
He’s the congressman who spent 17 years in Washington without passing a bill to help the people of Ohio.
But we’ve shown who we are, too.
We are the campaign that made national news at the DNC, exposing Jim Jordan’s abuses of power.
We are the grassroots movement knocking on doors, making phone calls, and building a powerful coalition to bring real change to Ohio.
We are the team that’s been out every day, fighting for affordable healthcare, veterans' rights, women’s rights and reproductive freedom, and working families' everyday needs.
We have a real shot at flipping OH-04 and defeating Jim Jordan, but it will take all of us to step up and show what we’re made of.
You don’t have to be from Ohio to make a difference. You can volunteer from anywhere, donate to fuel our ads and help spread the word.
So let’s make sure we leave it all on the field. As Michelle said, “Our fate is in our hands.”
My campaign, my team, and supporters from all throughout the district are fired up. I wish you were here so you could feel the energy, it’s palpable. People can feel the change coming and we’re so excited, but It ain’t over until November 6th!
I want to blow him out of the water so bad there is absolutely no doubt in his mind just how much we DO NOT WANT HIM. Join our mission and movement.
Trust me, you’re going to want to brag to your friends that you helped fire Jim Jordan.
Please give whatever you can today, and let’s make history together. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240831_michell_obame_dnc_link2]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

body:
Ilhan doesn't fund her campaigns the way a lot of her colleagues in Congress do. And that's only possible because she knows she can count on all of us to have her back when it matters most.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1336%2E791427%2E0BjihA)

Friends -
If your inbox looks anything like ours do, it's probably filled with emails from campaigns and organizations asking for your financial support.
Fundraising deadlines, new polls, breaking news around the clock... we know it can get overwhelming at times.
That's why our hope is that when you get emails from Ilhan and our team, you don't take them as an annoyance, but a sign of just how important your support is to our campaign.
Now, when we look at our fundraising numbers for August, things have slowed down quite a bit since Ilhan and our grassroots movement won our primary in Minnesota earlier this month.
We planned for that, and that's okay. But the truth is, we still have important goals to meet for the weeks, months — and yes, years — ahead.
You see, all these texts and emails we send drive the overwhelming majority (over 95%!) of donations to Ilhan's campaigns. And if we're going to continue building our movement in Minnesota and across the country to lay the groundwork for the campaigns to come, we need to keep our eyes on the ball.
That's why we're asking:

Only around 2,000 of the challenges were successful, and another 3,000 or so voters had to update some documentation.
Don't worry, we did the math: That means 99% of the challenges brought forward were baseless accusations designed to suppress turnout in a critical election.
Yet opponents of voting rights have expanded Georgia's voter challenge system, Team, and created additional hurdles to vote. Straight from CNN, Team:
" Republican-backed legislation headed to Georgia Gov. Brian Kemp’s desk would establish new rules for challenging voters’ eligibility and make it easier to qualify for the presidential ballot – changes that could have consequences in this fall’s elections in a closely watched battleground state. "
A brief history before we get to why this change is important -- after the 2020 election triggered widespread false claims of voter fraud in Georgia, voter fraud organizations based in other states have driven deluded individuals in Georgia to lodge tens of thousands of voter eligibility challenges .
The 2021 Georgia voter suppression law made it so a single voter could bring an unlimited number of challenges, and election officials in some large counties have been inundated with demands to remove voters from the rolls. The vast majority of these challenges were eventually thrown out, but the effect on voter turnout was chilling .
So of course now opponents of voting rights were so thrilled with that result that they included a separate provision in this new 2024 bill that makes it easier to uphold challenges to voter registrations, with a clear goal to reduce turnout by picking and choosing whose votes get to count. And now the Governor has signed it into law.
Voter suppression is real, Team, both here in Georgia and across the country. Push back on these cynical voter challenges with $25 or whatever you can right now to protect the right to vote in Georgia and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=083124_1&amount=25]

# A Public Conversation on Trafficking in America, Rank Choice Voting, and Election

We cordially invite you to an important event focused on safeguarding our freedoms and upholding the fundamental values of our nation: “Public Discussion on Human Trafficking, Ranked Choice Voting, and Electoral Integrity.”
**Event Details:****When** : Wednesday, September 18 **Time** : 7:00 PM (Doors open at 6:00 PM, and a cash bar will be available)**Where** : VFW Post 399, 465 Riverside Avenue, Westport, CT (lower level - rear entrance)
**Speakers Include:** Lt Gen Rod Bishop (USAF, Ret), Chairman of STARRS.usDiscussing Marxism in government.
Joe Oltmann, Conservative Daily in DenverReporting on human trafficking, just back from a fact-finding trip to Guatemala.
CT State Senator Rob SampsonAddressing the implications and importance of rank-choice voting.
Linda Szykowicz, Fight Voter Fraud Focusing on clean elections and voter rolls in Connecticut.This is a rare opportunity to hear from esteemed leaders and experts on topics critical to our nation’s future.
The event will provide insights into the pressing issues of human trafficking, the integrity of our elections, and the influence of Marxism within our government.
**Get Your Tickets:** General Admission - $30 (https://connecticutcentinal.com/vfw/)Premier Admission - $100 ](https://connecticutcentinal.com/vfw/)Livestream - $25 (https://connecticutcentinal.com/vfw/)
_A percentage of the proceeds will be donated to VFW Post 399 to_ _support their infrastructure development efforts._
**This event is more than just a discussion—it's a call to action for those who believe in the enduring power of freedom and the Constitution.**
We hope to see you there as we explore these critical issues together.

Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ecfc1134850b4677816cabf69f5dda1e&_e=mbgS11hxjYCB3KHDSg3Hyk_3GUWcMjn_PciwixeStxYyS0uhITUGwo3Wxe8Q2haHgzAQINdwUEbJC0EpQKxCTEDEMq7gAcEPn80QkzbwJ9lJEhgr1ThkWm1gAbI9ncOhCmaCYhNJfH33zyQQhvXJqW9Qeroi4T7EiBblKyRRd1U99YFg_hcuo0zH08t64tMaHnk8Rlh_fiVJcFpc8ACyCvBa7Crkm5fijTKiV3Ps3OVCRBKyhIz6QGY_dZ9_WcJ3dISZsp4ieGXgM2K2f6x3MHdt6IsLooZCIAkHv-FJhBZz7dIXmYv1dpJNxqOc0JD5wyXbmTPZBhfpqdqKC-hIr8KrOircgDnoVxLewSdvO42NOYrVRmhd9FOU7wZgeAaJtvZ1VJjmJRqo_qlszutFV2I5FDtRbkFynnlUhHjMNok%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

He laid out his cynical and divisive worldview for the millionth time. He spoke about his extreme, radical, dangerous agenda. And he put us — our campaign — square in the middle of his warpath. He attacked me multiple times, said I "shouldn't even be allowed to run." But most importantly, he said if he wins in Arizona he wins the presidency. He said it himself: He has to go straight through us to have any chance at winning this November. But I’ve got a message for him: **Show some respect. ** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91928378/495428549/1669863775?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_EOM_AC90_20240831_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzI2MTg4MzgtYzc2Ny1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xKO_QyC9p6iJtr-_iuCraOyKvqWPmuMRaqOin9tbCYY=) After years of attacking and insulting veterans like John McCain, or Gold Star Parents like the Khans, the fallen of Belleau Wood, even Medal of Honor recipients — show some respect for the military, for veterans, and for our families. **We’ve got your number, Donald. And we will not let you win. ** This election is going to come down to Trump and Lake versus you and me. Can I count on you to have my back as I take the fight to them from now until November? **[If you’re still with me, please, make a split $20 donation with the Arizona Democratic Party and support our work out in Arizona. clean_body: I don’t want to give it too much attention, but Trump spoke in Arizona last Thursday and was joined by my opponent, Kari Lake, at a rally on Friday. | = I don’t want to give it too much attention, but Trump spoke in Arizona twice last week, including one time with my opponent, Kari Lake, at a rally in Phoenix. He laid out his cynical and divisive worldview for the millionth time. He spoke about his extreme, radical, dangerous agenda. And he put us — our campaign — square in the middle of his warpath. He attacked me multiple times, said I "shouldn't even be allowed to run." But most importantly, he said if he wins in Arizona he wins the presidency. He said it himself: He has to go straight through us to have any chance at winning this November. But I’ve got a message for him: Show some respect. = After years of attacking and insulting veterans like John McCain, or Gold Star Parents like the Khans, the fallen of Belleau Wood, even Medal of Honor recipients — show some respect for the military, for veterans, and for our families. We’ve got your number, Donald. And we will not let you win. This election is going to come down to Trump and Lake versus you and me. Can I count on you to have my back as I take the fight to them from now until November? = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be split between the Arizona Democratic Party and Ruben Gallego immediately: | | = = | = = | = = We can win. It has helped lower prescription drug costs, further the clean energy transition, and ensure the largest corporations pay their fair share. Michael worked to ensure the IRA became law and brought home huge investments for Colorado’s working families. This landmark accomplishment only passed because of our Democratic majorities in the House and Senate — something we lost after the 2022 midterms and something Michael is working to change this November. [**We need your help before our fundraising deadline on Saturday to ensure these efforts can continue to finally flip New Mexico RED.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=ed5bee225a1e4577bc9d388730613d3a&_e=HgcZahpsmdgw2D-8P2wr7Fjs6ICnqtpx3OEx24IxzBf2jsZxbDvLqk-4MaDfrRzvVmTwLLgwLauX2yj8-eJxqAgWrR3aScXbeEXj5ZyJDPx8-HZvgvHl7PYjcrZFGR4p7MzkbIA20kg0t6Jbd0eW4dA28uKEUXlY5k74OtkPw2eVbI0vbFYXhpBcAutSLc0G2p8dBsOej8Q5S4r3BIIX2vp8PjGb9jLUE_jTwQrjRTVK2eWhIrX83_TOr03Cn66LY0VvpDXKQOdMTpolwoI4O2YLgOu93rpVb_cNmiwTpL97NU2DQXZwsYJbkI8zz-Uc8cwDepLv9hPF2Tl0hQn-4awi4nvxSPDyzOhPZnIDWoAwnfCYAaIl7gZzQiuetx-gf-MHk5WIj3nWXWJZMUXhig%3D%3D)

Team Nella

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Dear Peter,
On August 23, Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. endorsed Donald Trump and suspended his campaign in the battleground states.
RFK Jr.'s name remains on the ballot in 40 states. After the election, if he receives **5% or more of the popular vote nationwide** , he can create an independent political party.
Such a party could start running candidates for office in 2025 - without the expensive need to gather huge numbers of petition signatures. Such a party could be an ongoing institution advocating for the ideas and policies Bobby represents.
Here's the thing: We have already won a spectacular victory.
A year and a half ago, chronic disease, endless wars, censorship, and corporate control over our regulatory agencies _were barely a whisper in the national conversation_.
These critical issues—central to the well-being and future of our nation—were systematically ignored by the mainstream media and the political establishment.
Yet today, thanks to Bobby Kennedy’s unwavering commitment and the powerful platform he now shares with President Trump, **_we’re witnessing a stunning shift in the national conversation_.**
These key issues are no longer buried in obscurity; **they are now front and center in the minds of millions of Americans** , sparking conversations and demanding action.
Last Friday, **over 100 million Americans tuned in to hear Bobby** boldly outline the four critical pillars of his campaign:
* Ending the chronic disease epidemic:
* Ending the Forever Wars, especially the Ukraine War:
* Ending the dictatorship of censorship: and,
* Ending the corporate capture of our regulatory agencies.

This is more than just a campaign— _it’s a revolution to reclaim our country’s health, freedom, and integrity._
And Bobby’s megaphone just got a whole lot bigger!
Prior to last Friday, Bobby was excluded from the mainstream media. Yes, our social media content reached many people outside the traditional news networks. But now, Bobby’s voice can reach over 100 million voters in a single speech—a **hundredfold increase** , an increase that changes everything.
This isn’t just an incremental shift; it’s a seismic leap that presents us with **a unique and unprecedented opportunity to fundamentally change the course of America.**
[Every dollar given now has an impact far greater than ever before. We are engaging the entire nation.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-aug31-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=influence_eom_8_31_24_nd1&n=4)

**Your support at this critical juncture** will allow us to optimize and capitalize on this new, vast audience.
We will amplify Bobby’s message through targeted social media campaigns, produce compelling videos that inspire millions more to join our cause, and mobilize in all 40 states where Bobby is on the ballot, ensuring every voice is heard.
Every dollar contributed - every vote cast - strengthens RFK Jr’s leverage to implement the needed reforms.
This is not just about continuing the fight—**it’s about seizing the momentum to create a transformative change that will echo through the generations.**
This is our moment to make history. The momentum is on our side, and with your support, we can fundamentally change America.
[Will you stand with Bobby today and help us take this movement to the next level? ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-aug31-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=influence_eom_8_31_24_nd1&n=6)

As we approach the end of the month and the FEC reporting deadline, your contribution is more important than ever.
By giving generously today, you’ll help ensure that we end this month with the momentum to drive this revolution forward.

Stop the Gender Radicals
| Peter, I’m Riley Gaines. You may have heard my name in the news. I’m an All-American swimmer -- but I’m better known for my role in the fight to save women’s sports.
Women and girls have a right to compete fairly, and to private locker rooms. I speak out strongly for all female athletes like me who’ve been forced to compete against men. **Just this year, a female golfer lost her spot in the U.S. Women’s Open qualifier at Bradenton to a man, James “Hailey” Davidson.** Then, USA Today _took down_ a brilliant op-ed by Republican Senator John Kennedy. In the op-ed, he demanded to know if “inclusion” should be prioritized over fairness and safety when it comes to sports. But Peter, I won’t be censored! Instead, I seek to build a community of thousands of sensible Americans who know the difference between a man and a woman. I started the Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute so that women would have a place to speak out against the gender ideology radicals. Please, join me and stand for women, free speech, and common sense.

Since we launched our campaign, tens of thousands of grassroots Democrats have jumped in to support our movement to elect a new generation of leadership focused on delivering for working people. I've been the underdog most of my life. My parents were immigrants. We didn't come from money or fancy titles. When I first ran for public office, I had people telling me I had no chance. And right now, even with all our momentum, we're up against a lot. My opponent has spent $2 million of his vast fortune in this race so far, and he's going to pour everything he has to try and win this seat for Donald Trump and the MAGA agenda. **To this day, I carry the values he passed on to me. He dedicated his life to service to others and always stressed the value of a good education. **That's why he got a Regents Scholarship to Columbia University and became an aviator in the U.S. Navy. His story is one of hard work and determination – of perseverance through the worst of human cruelty and violence.
In my work in Congress, I look to him for inspiration –**so, as the first Democrat in Chester County to hold a national seat in more than 165 years, I'm not going to let the GOP replace me with a far-right challenger who would inevitably be a rubber stamp on the chaos and harmful policies of Republicans in Washington.** We've got A LOT of work to do if we want to defend our progress in November. Here's where things stand:
**FIRST:** The GOP rallied their millionaire donors to target key Democratic seats like mine across the country.
**THEN:** My opponent is someone who said recently “I want to align myself with President Trump and his ideas.
**NOW:** If we can't gather enough resources to resist the GOP's attacks, we'll risk losing this seat and all of the incredible progress we've made.
Derek, I've dedicated my service in the House to making life better for all Pennsylvanians. I do this for my family and yours. **But right now, with so much up against us, I'm counting on this team to make sure we can continue this progress.**
**To power my campaign, we set a goal to raise $5,000 by our end-of-month deadline. Listen, we can't stop these suppressive laws from going into effect -- at least to start. But we can draw attention to them, we can use them to organize and to turn out voters, and we can work to repeal these laws or fight them in court.
We must keep fighting these ploys to codify single-party power and control into state law. RUSH $25 or more right now to protect voting rights and make every vote count >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=083124_2&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=083124_2&amount=25]
Democracy Docket: Louisiana Governor Signs Multiple Anti-Voter Bills and More Are Pending [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=083124_2&amount=25]
Louisiana's governor, Jeff Landry, has now signed eleven anti-voter bills into law in the last couple of weeks. He started the month off with these seven new suppressive laws:
➜ House Bill 285 requires the state secretary of state’s office to create an election integrity division to perform many duties, including “ conducting independent investigations into allegations of election irregularities .”
➜ House Bill 476 restricts people from delivering more than one absentee ballot via mail unless they are sending ballots on behalf of immediate family members.
➜ Senate Bill 155 only allows individuals to assist with more than one absentee ballot if they are helping immediate family members.
➜ Senate Bill 218 requires someone assisting a voter to provide their address and relationship to the voter and reveal if they were paid to assist.
➜ Senate Bill 226 requires that an absentee ballot that is missing information and is not fixed by the voter is considered a challenged ballot that is only counted if the majority of the election board decides it should be.
➜ Senate Bill 449 defines a qualified voter or elector as “ a person who has the proper qualifications provided by law to be entitled to vote and who is lawfully registered to vote .”
➜ Senate Bill 101 bans ranked-choice voting in Louisiana elections.
Every single one of these bills was passed with an eye on adding barriers to voting, reducing ballot access, and suppressing participation in Louisiana's elections. Opponents of voting rights are trying to codify their pathway to power in state law instead of winning elections fair and square.
Team: We can't stand by when laws like this pass that harm voting rights. Help us fight back in Louisiana and beyond with $25 or whatever you can today and make sure every voice is heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=083124_2&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=083124_2&amount=15]
GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=083124_2&amount=25]
GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=083124_2&amount=50]
GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=083124_2&amount=100]
GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=083124_2&amount=250]
Other Amount [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=083124_2&amount=35]
As if that wasn't enough, he added these four new suppressive laws in the last few days :
➜ House Bill 506 requires individuals and entities to register with the Secretary of State before conducting voter registration drives. This is another attack on 3rd party voting rights groups like ours.
➜ House Bill 581 criminalizes being a witness on more than one absentee ballot for non-immediate family members and requires witnesses to provide their mailing address (another restriction on voter registration organizations).
➜ House Bill 114 creates new procedures for maintaining active voter lists and specifies conditions under which individuals can be purged from voter rolls, making it easier for the state to kick people off the list of registered voters.
➜ Senate Bill 436 requires individuals to provide proof of citizenship to register to vote despite no proof of non-citizens participating in elections in Louisiana or elsewhere across the country.
This is all a cynical, partisan ploy to suppress the vote and stay in power. It's the same playbook we've seen repeated by opponents of voting rights in states nationwide.
State laws like this are exactly why we needed the Voting Rights Act in the first place. Pitch in $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can to help protect our fundamental right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=083124_2&amount=25]

name: Mark Kelly
subject: What it's going to take to win.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
Wherever I go, people ask me what it’s going to take to hold the Senate or flip the House this year.
#

Hey team, it's Mark.
I’ve spent a lot of time over the last year traveling the country to support friends in tough races. Wherever I go, people ask me what it’s going to take to hold the Senate or flip the House this year.
It’s a good question. Our margins are extremely thin, and we’re on defense in far too many races.

body:
To see Trump use Section 60 of Arlington National Cemetery for his own political gain — for his staff to verbally and physically abuse the official trying to protect the sanctity of that hallowed ground — is something I never anticipated.
#
This week has not been easy.
For years, I’ve cringed every time I hear the reporting about Trump calling members of our military "suckers" and those who died in battle "losers."
But to see Trump use Section 60 of Arlington National Cemetery for his own political gain — for his staff to verbally and physically abuse the official trying to protect the sanctity of that hallowed ground — is something I never anticipated.
**My name is Karen Meredith, I am a Gold Star mother, and my son is buried in Section 60.**
My only child, 1LT Ken Ballard, joined the Army after graduating high school in 1995. As an Army granddaughter, Army daughter, Army sister, and Army mom, I couldn't be more proud of his decision.
My son deployed to Iraq in May of 2003, and 384 days later he was killed while fighting an Iranian-backed militia in Najaf. He had been scheduled to return home eight days earlier, but his tour was extended.
Ken, like others in our family, were not "suckers" for making the decision to serve their country. He was not a "loser" either.
Ken, and those who put on the uniform, are the best this country has to offer. But to Trump, they’re nothing more than props for his campaign.
Sometimes it's hard to know how to respond in these moments. For me, I have been active in the Gold Star and Veteran's communities as an advocate for Military families. I feel as if my work resisting Trump is an extension of that work.
And I am thankful to have a mechanism to do that through VoteVets.
I know that in 2024 — just like 2020 — VoteVets will have a critical role to play in keeping Trump out of the White House. And anything I can do to help, I am in. So today, I am asking for your help in that cause:

---
Hi Peter,

I know it’s Labor Day weekend, so I’ll make this quick.

It may be a holiday, but my team and I still have a crucial month-end fundraising deadline at midnight tonight.

We’re closing in on Martin Heinrich and on the cusp of turning this into a full-on toss-up race for Senate here in New Mexico.

_But missing this deadline would compromise all the momentum we’ve built._

[**Can you chip in just $7 or more before midnight to ensure we hit our August goal and stay on course to pull off a victory in this race?**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=30252aab92994cf5b90742dcff1af52f&_e=QGV_QCNpjnLGSIrym_9KeEiiS69VtVBjh9jDn5addHGxgeK3s_Z6XRo3mdQ4GHmkG0vKRJ2oZ4Av1mBc4W_GDSeXA8hS1R5vgjyfB3RLGI6vs1FGHkv677x56L97-ec4XOq454TJkw6pnnSKKKr-j4aKyPoll5fcwaafTPFqIATwANcfM6urxxv_gPs7KmRJQ924AZut3vG4GbaAsTb8Y5AQJenzlk67M4FjSxnl-DvzUt93AmqLntNDaEYSPgH4anfYovxA0KKobyXGOvYPA_I9B0v3oPPHewwZ4ckW6_kD5ZM3wanapOjASvOVqLyflBYq0BgmLV_7qikYlEkCfkhtab1TNe31PrQATSGBu52O52H3U1xkZZj8P5zrfEXTglFMxdy2QjRqqFegWVKiPQ%3D%3D)

Thank you so much for any support you can give today!

_**-Nella Domenici**_

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

We engage marginalized communities through door-to-door canvassing, phone calls, relational organizing, text messaging, digital ads, and earned media. We’ve built trust in communities across the Commonwealth because we’ve spent real time with people — working hand in hand to make Pennsylvania — and this country — better.
Whether we’re working to elect progressive champions to City Hall or fighting racist slumlords, our “how” remains the same. **And here’s our team’s plan for the 2024 election:**
* We will make nearly 4.5 million voter contacts before Election Day.

* We’ll register 35,000 voters.
* We’ll engage 300,000 Black voters in organizing conversations.

body:
Hi Peter,
I don’t want to take up too much of your well-earned Labor Day weekend, but this is really important.
My team and I have been monitoring our progress on the goal we set for our first fundraising deadline of the General Election since we were named the Democratic nominee. With only a few hours to go, we’re roughly $2,033 short.
That’s why I wanted to reach out to you personally, Peter. This is our first major deadline since we had to go all out to win the primary, and I want to make sure extremists like Derrick Van Orden see our strength in numbers. Can you add a last minute donation of $3 to help chip away at our goal?
Click here: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cooke-q3-2024**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91939809/495469737/645503820?refcode=em-8.31.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZTBhYjI0ZS1lOTY3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gDDOvSQ63U2Y0H-PDRZKXJo8T3zEx8CXiD-sgMSd5v0=)
We’re starting the General Election at a disadvantage, with Van Orden having amassed millions in special interest dollars for this moment.**In this people-powered campaign, every dollar makes a difference.** This race won’t be easy, but I know we can do it – together.
If you can give even a little bit right now, it would truly make a difference: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cooke-q3-2024**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91939810/495469738/645503820?refcode=em-8.31.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZTBhYjI0ZS1lOTY3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gDDOvSQ63U2Y0H-PDRZKXJo8T3zEx8CXiD-sgMSd5v0=)

She told me about how she has to travel to the hospital every single month for a procedure. Since then, I keep thinking about who around me is like “Betsy,” fighting the battle of the day without anyone knowing it. I’m running for re-election for “Betsy” and everyone like her, but we’re facing our August deadline tonight, and we’re coming up short of our goal. Can you chip in $7 or whatever you can to help us finish strong, to keep helping the “Betsy’s” of IL-17? Here’s a good link: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q3-2024**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Zwbi_oGuyvo3VRJwAKWCfg~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRotiP6P0TkaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2VzLXEzLTIwMjQ_Y2l0eT1DcmVzY28mY291bnRyeT1VUyZlbWFpbD1kcHdpbGxpczY3JTQwZ21haWwuY29tJmZpcnN0bmFtZT1QZXRlciZsYXN0bmFtZT1XaWxsaXMmcGhvbmU9JTJCMSslMjg3MTclMjkrODY3LTUzMDkmcmVmY29kZT1lbS04LjMxLjI0LWFsbC1hJnJlZmNvZGVObXJvQm1pZD00NzI3Njc2MzAmc3RhdGU9UEEmemlwPTE4MzI2VwNzcGNCCmbPDZ_TZmaPaTdSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAb) Think of all of the confidence, perseverance, and strength we may not notice in a stranger's eyes sitting at a stoplight, walking to school, buying groceries, or happily walking into the hospital for the day’s procedure. Everyone’s fighting a battle. We need to make sure the people around us are being lifted up instead of being cut down, whether we think they need it or not. I didn’t go to Congress just to be a politician or have a title. I went to Congress to represent people like Betsy, my neighbors. She told me about how she has to travel to the hospital every single month for a procedure. Since then, I keep thinking about who around me is like “Betsy,” fighting the battle of the day without anyone knowing it. I’m running for re-election for “Betsy” and everyone like her, but we’re facing our August deadline tonight, and we’re coming up short of our goal. Can you chip in $7 or whatever you can to help us finish strong, to keep helping the “Betsy’s” of IL-17? Here’s a good link: Think of all of the confidence, perseverance, and strength we may not notice in a stranger's eyes sitting at a stoplight, walking to school, buying groceries, or happily walking into the hospital for the day’s procedure. Everyone’s fighting a battle. We need to make sure the people around us are being lifted up instead of being cut down, whether we think they need it or not. I didn’t go to Congress just to be a politician or have a title. I went to Congress to represent people like Betsy, my neighbors. And I’ll never let them be treated like pawns for special interests or extremists. Ahead of our monthly deadline, help me be a good neighbor to them by chipping in $7. Because there is nothing stronger than people power! Here's that link again: Thank you in advance for your support. – Eric ---|--- | Paid for by Eric Sorensen for Illinois. Peter -- we’ll be honest: **We need your help.** Tonight at midnight is our August FEC deadline, and all eyes are on us to see if we can turn our momentum into action. That’s why we pulled the records of our top supporters, and here's what we saw for you: **YOUR SUPPORTER RECORD** **NAME** : Peter **STATUS** : NOT A HARRIS-WALZ DONOR (YET!) **RECOMMENDED ACTION** : MAKE YOUR FIRST $25 DONATION TO KAMALA’S CAMPAIGN | | | [DONATE NOW](https://click.contact.kamalaharris.com/ss/c/u001.NV3IV8RXB3BPG-RgoenRivizIuY7_hyRTlr0Ev1A4jyRess_Z46ivJQExIi6hcFAl8LNohi49U_cXelCpDCLkuKdr-qmYdo5gIgWJt2YJmhRVP_stUMhldJwWGHen0k1nZbzMdNlwOP1h6q-Y5TXCDPykgdEGHM1ZRCbfYR326kl6sLGaZ75W3VMa6jB7xUXyAMcPgx55S8OsLdzY6fklJoI9E_Aoqon_uv4blITB_B5iRAtMCph2_i-g5GToddgudFMMHAgFclBOiupn1ONY7Ib42Oo-_AG06nhoKePROgXW2Jy-ATcsW8sGH0FhWOqRKQC9XNuES3smp4zjlPGiuZKzNazs9Iw938l12kvLWJDstZwFQZxL_SnrWga3d7Dmwl-nXquqtOC-cTypVm4TcsWfAzLo9eZBOek0Q5xsDE0xVtYdWdsIVHVmBrEstmYddj4GCLxqZtAH461tra8-H2Ch0VadBsTRRzlyncB-9yssW0-ui3NGOAWZsyubyxhYxXhGJgLj6yIqbapTnXgp6sLmN7Elzsr_ZeJQpwvEow/49d/XRdiwMR4Ryi-748PzX1bnQ/h0/h001.iH2vM_lHlt0rPefP_gziNokBFFj-nZ6zxW3H5DCPwq8)

We know that one donation in and of itself might not seem like it can make a big difference. But trust us when we say that lots and lots of people are already chipping in today, and it all adds up when we band together.
With your support, we can meet our end-of-month fundraising goal and power this campaign to success.
Your $25 will help get out the vote in crucial battleground states across the country. Your $25 will help launch ads advocating for the Vice President and fight back against misinformation. **Your $25 -- today -- will help defeat Donald Trump.**
